admit_content_size maps WGC ContentSize into pooled-texture bounds: nonpositive or over-pool sizes rejected; first fitting size becomes baseline, only an unchanged baseline is admitted, later changes return None as a real resize.

Policy clocks share one monotonic domain; WGC may stamp up to 13ms early, absorbed by MAX_SOURCE_LEAD of 1_000_000 100ns ticks over 100ms. Border capability once false stays false; border_available gates admission even when state looks healthy.
Depends only on capsule_registry Clock for timestamps; no I/O or threads. Callers supply generation, geometry and border status from native capture and registry queries.

requires_restart states are terminal inside this object: admit_frame and status never recover from them. Reusing the same CaptureHealth after Closed, DeviceLost, ResizeRequired or GenerationMismatch silently keeps failing; construct a new one.

CapturePipeline is the runtime capture-to-recorder driver: generic only at the capture input S: FrameSource, concrete P11 Recorder output, advancing one take-capture, admit, pace and pump step per caller-supplied monotonic Instant.

Input boundary is FrameSource with take_latest, state against WindowRegistry, and stop. NativeSource adapts NativeCapture take_latest, poll_state and stop; the executable caller wiring lives outside this file.
new builds a stopped-flagged pipeline with live_pump false; new_live sets live_pump true so pacing stays independent of the bounded pipe writer. Recorder state and counters are exposed read-only.

Each tick calls take_latest before state(registry). Only Healthy admits, paces and pumps; Waiting returns Waiting without touching the pacer. Frames move source to recorder.admit, then pace, then pump_one or begin_pump plus poll_pump.

admit_source_state allows Healthy always, and Waiting only before start with no frame; all other states fail closed. Tick outcomes are Waiting (never claims a write), Idle (no confirmed write) and Written.

Failed admission, any non-waiting unhealthy state, or any recorder admit, pace or pump error stops the source, interrupts the recorder, marks stopped true, and returns Source or Recorder error; pipeline never completes on those paths.

stop first stops capture then drains and validates the recorder into a RecordingReceipt; failed capture stop interrupts the recorder and cannot publish. abort always attempts both stops, never drains media, never returns a receipt. Ticks after stop return Stopped.

User sees recording that never starts and stays waiting, a mid-session abort with no file, or stop failing to produce a finished receipt after the window closed, device was lost, recorder errored, or stop was called twice.

Flags started and stopped: first admitted frame sets started true; any terminal source or recorder failure and any stop or abort sets stopped true permanently. started gates whether an empty Healthy tick reports Waiting or Idle.

tick runs blocking pump_one; tick_nonblocking polls confirmed writes without waiting then begins a new pump. live_pump selects the nonblocking path for tick. Best-effort stops ignore errors with let _ while receipt-blocking stop propagates them.
Depends on WindowRegistry for live state queries, NativeCapture poll_state and stop, concrete Recorder admit, pace, pump, interrupt and stop, plus authority Journal for the stop receipt.

take_latest runs before state, so a frame pulled in the same tick as a transition to unhealthy is discarded while the pipeline tears down. Callers must not assume a returned frame implies Healthy admission.

ControlRuntime is the confirmed control admission point owning the writer and journal: it authenticates broker, operator and organizer intents, checks confirmations, writes durable intent and result facts, then dispatches typed effects to the single actor.

open takes a Journal, epoch and allowed roots; it rejects zero epoch, epoch mismatch, empty roots or non-canonical roots, replays confirmed intent and result records, and never restores folder plaintext, tokens or in-flight effects.

Broker entry handle validates peer liveness, broker identity and epoch, parses closed cafe.control_intent.v1 JSON within 16384 bytes, and requires a live confirmation token whose identity and fingerprint match and have not expired.

Operator path mints its own confirmation after local-UI decoding; organizer native-plan path only accepts Start or StopRecording with matching epoch. Neither path lets remote data mint confirmations or choose origin.

Wire IntentBody becomes trusted ControlAction, then fingerprint hash plus effect_id ctl.sha256(request_id); SetFolder, Start, Stop and SendToObs become ControlDispatch commands carrying ApprovedFolder capabilities and frozen capsule snapshots to the actor queue.

SetFolder must canonicalize under an authorized root with no parent components, absolute path, no symlink ancestors and existing directory; recording actions require known capsule ids. Folders are rechecked immediately before dispatch and again by revalidate before files open.

Reply states Pending, Committed, Rejected, Interrupted, Blocked. Journal intent marks in_flight true; only actor completion appends the result, clears pending folders and roots on Applied, and replays Committed, Pending or Interrupted for duplicate request ids.

Rejects invalid intents, token-shape and reflection cases, unknown confirmations, binding or expiry mismatches, stale revisions, missing recording folder as Blocked recording_folder_required, and poisoned runtime as Blocked authority_requires_recovery with no dispatch.

Organizer subfolder validates 1-64 byte names, frozen root equality and journal flush before mkdir; creation is guarded and revalidated, and failures record Interrupted without authorizing the child. Intent flush failure precedes directory creation.

User sees start refused until a folder is chosen, folder_not_authorized after moving or symlinking the folder, confirmation_required or expired retries, duplicate request returning the prior receipt, or blocked state demanding recovery after disk write failure.

Start and SendToObs freeze capsule feeds and require exactly one live binding per feed with nonzero window and layout generations; Stop needs no binding. Actor delivery uses bounded try_send within CONTROL_REPLY_DEADLINE; overflow yields Interrupted, never Committed.
Confirmations are bounded to 64 pending entries with 30s TTL, random hex tokens, entropy-collision check and 16-root capacity; expired entries are retained until next issuance prunes them.

Depends on authority Journal for durable intent and result records and snapshots, authority_auth peers and entropy for identity and tokens, and ControlEffects adapters for real folder, recording and OBS actions.

OperatorConfirmation wire values never leave trusted code and ActorControlJob copies no secret token; the actor must recompare frozen bindings and capsule generations against current state before touching windows or files.
Discord discovery policy maps a live WindowView to Popout, Main, NotDiscord or Unknown so pairing anchors only measured Discord surfaces; native title and class measurements are still PENDING-LIVE.

classify_discord_window first runs the pattern table, then applies the measured Chrome_WidgetWin_1 fallback: empty title stays Unknown, title ending in Discord becomes Main, any other nonempty title becomes Popout.

Each pattern needs nonempty class, nonempty prefix or suffix, Popout or Main classification, exact class equality, title prefix plus suffix match with length covering both affixes; malformed rules are skipped, never matched.
Matching is single-pass: first matching classification is remembered, repeats of the same classification are kept, and a second distinct classification fails closed to Unknown for that window.

Non-allowlisted executables return NotDiscord immediately without consulting patterns. Allowlisted Discord.exe, DiscordPTB.exe and DiscordCanary.exe with no pattern match return Unknown, never Main or Popout.

User sees a Discord window that cannot be selected for capture: unmeasured titles stay Unknown, wrong executable casing variants or path-qualified names are NotDiscord, and conflicting rules collapse to Unknown.

Control and data enter as WindowView executable, class and title treated as untrusted data and leave as a copied DiscordWindowClass enum; no handle, title text or executable substring is returned or granted anchoring power.
Depends only on windows_window_registry WindowView fields executable, class and title; tests build views through WindowRegistry fixtures rather than live enumeration.

Window text remains data: executable substrings such as Discord.exe.other, path-qualified names or title resemblance alone never grant permission. Case-insensitive executable match is exact filename only, including the .exe suffix.
Classification is a pure synchronous function over a borrowed view and a static pattern slice with no locks, globals mutated, I/O or allocation beyond the returned enum copy.

Single-owner paced recorder that validates plan/profile/binary, records durable media intent, spawns supervised FFmpeg, paces slots through a bounded queue into one ordered pipe writer, then decode-validates and publishes the artifact.

Pre-launch gate that validates profile, pins binary SHA-256, enforces encoder licensing policy, checks encoder inventory, and proves the encoder accepts probe dimensions with a 2-frame write plus artifact decode before any recording.

Start path: validate_plan plus profile, re-verify binary_digest against approval, append_media_intent to Journal, build complete_argv, spawn ChildSupervisor, create Pacer at origin. start_ready returns fresh Instant; start preserves caller origin.

Async bootstrap: rejects existing probe_path, digests binary, applies OperatorApprovedExternalTest or Production policy gates, checks -encoders inventory, runs 2-frame probe child, validates artifact, deletes probe file, returns Preflight on success.

Live loop API: admit offers frames to Pacer, pace selects one due slot into queue, begin_pump submits to pipe worker, poll_pump/finish_write collect acks, stop drains/finishes/validates/publishes, interrupt aborts child with no receipt.

Frames flow admit->Pacer.offer->pacer.select->VecDeque queue->mpsc sender->background task write_confirmed_chunks with flush per chunk->ChildStdin->WriteAck channel->accept_write counts written_frames/bytes only after confirmed==bytes.

Control flow: complete_argv builds rawvideo bgra pipe args plus -thread_queue_size 16 for hardware encoders; ChildSupervisor spawns FFmpeg; stop runs validate_artifact decoding staged file with ffprobe-style -progress pipe:1 frame count before journal.publish_media.

States Recording, Finalizing, Complete, Interrupted. stop rejects Interrupted and Complete, moves to Finalizing, on any pump/close/finish/validate/journal error moves to Interrupted and aborts. interrupt forces Interrupted and aborts. Complete only after publish.

Admitted frame width, height and pixels length must equal profile.frame_bytes width*height*4; mismatch clears preview, forces Interrupted and returns InvalidProfile. frame_bytes rejects zero/overflow via checked mul.
Binary SHA-256 digest must equal pinned digest at with_profile and again at start_with_clock; mismatch returns ExecutableChanged and never spawns. Digest is hex SHA-256 of whole binary file.

Profile valid only if width, height, fps_num/den, queue_capacity, write/stop timeouts, max_lateness/hold all nonzero plus frame_bytes and PacerProfile validate succeed; else InvalidProfile. pacer maps profile into fps plus lateness budgets.

Plan names must be <=128 bytes, end .mkv, not start with dot, no .., only alnum plus _-. Both staged and published names must be absent under non-symlink dir root, differ, plus non-empty media/journal ids; else InvalidPath.

FFmpeg argv is fixed: -hide_banner -loglevel error -nostdin -n -f rawvideo -pixel_format bgra -video_size WxH -framerate N/D [-thread_queue_size 16 if not ffv1] -i pipe:0 -an -c:v <encoder> -f matroska <output>. No software fallback.

If OperatorApprovedExternalTest pin check fails or Production requires non-ffv1 plus 64-hex digest equality plus ffmpeg 8.1.3 without gpl/libx264/nonfree, preflight returns BlockedAudit before spawning.
If -encoders output lacks encoder.name in column two, or 2-frame probe write/finish/validate fails, or spawn fails, preflight returns BlockedEncoder or Spawn and removes probe file.

When queue_len reaches queue_capacity without late_recovery, pace increments queue_full and backpressure, clears preview, enters Interrupted and returns QueueFull. With late_recovery it calls skip_late and drops instead of interrupting.

Pipe errors: zero write gives PartialFrame, first-chunk failure WriteFailed else PartialFrame, timeout WriteTimeout. accept_write records confirmed in last_partial/partial_bytes, backpressure on timeout, clears preview, Interrupts and returns the error.

stop fails closed: pump error, close_writer StopTimeout, child.finish ChildExit/StopTimeout, zero frames ArtifactInvalid, validate frame-count mismatch ArtifactInvalid, publish failure Journal; each clears preview, Interrupts and aborts.

User sees recording that never produces a published .mkv and stop returns an error; staged partial may remain while published file is absent because zero-frame output or decoded frame count not equal to written_frames is rejected as ArtifactInvalid.

User sees live recording abort after a stall or wrong-size frame: pace/admit clear the preview, move to Interrupted, and later stop/interrupt/pump calls fail with State, QueueFull, Pacer or InvalidProfile instead of continuing.

One ordered pipe owner: begin_pump takes child stdin once, spawns a task owning stdin plus bounded mpsc channels sized queue_capacity, checks index contiguity expected==written+outstanding, breaks on first failed ack. Recorder Drop aborts the task.

Child shutdown closes stdin, waits under stop_timeout, kills only if owned pid still matches, drains stderr task with timeout then aborts. Drop kills owned child and aborts stderr relay without waiting.

Bounded capture: tool_output caps stdout at 262144 bytes via bounded_read and drains stderr continuously; over-limit output becomes ArtifactInvalid. All waits use write_timeout/stop_timeout or 5s-equivalent deadline; stderr tasks are aborted on timeout.

Encoder policy: operator_selected maps exact OPERATOR_EXTERNAL_TEST_SHA256 c6caa189... to OperatorApprovedExternalTest else Production; external test requires hardware encoder plus exact pin on both actual and supplied; production requires ffmpeg version 8.1.3 prefix without forbidden flags.
Depends on authority_journal Journal for append_media_intent and publish_media, capture_frame_pool OwnedFrame pixels, recorder_pacer Pacer/PreviewSelector, tokio process/tasks/time, sha2 for digests.
PID ownership guard rejects pid 0/1, own process id, or child.id mismatch with ProcessOwnership before kill/wait; prevents signalling init, self, or a recycled child after spawn.

Deterministic crash recovery: open journal under exclusive lock, replay committed control records, rebuild media intent/receipt maps, and verify each published receipt against bytes on disk under media_root.
Single authority private-stdin runtime entry: wire module tree together and run runtime_main::run, blocking startup with CAFE_RUNTIME_BLOCKED:<code> on stderr and exit 1 on failure.

Closed private-stdin operator syntax gate: enforce 16KB frame cap, exact schema/kind, strict identifiers/lengths/geometry, and decimal-string clocks before any epoch, window, or executable check in main.

recover(path, media_root, session_id, epoch) opens Journal, rejects symlinked or non-dir media_root with Media, replays media_intent and media_published payloads, then validates files and returns Recovery with snapshot, media map, status, quarantined bytes and records.
Process entry main takes no args and returns nothing; it delegates to runtime_main::run and only formats the blocked exit path.

decode_operator(bytes) is the sole decoder for Snapshot, ListWindows, CreateCapsule, PairWindow, SetFolder, Start/StopRecording, SendToObs, ConfigureFfmpeg/Obs/Twitch, OrganizerPlanConfirm/Reject and SetAutoAnchor ops.

Journal records flow into BTreeMaps of intents and receipts keyed by media_id; each receipt is joined against its intent name and the file media_root/receipt_name, whose length and sha256_hex must match receipt byte_len and sha256.

Bytes are JSON-parsed into OperatorRequest with deny_unknown_fields at every level, then body.valid checks identifiers, bounds, ports, hashes and crop arithmetic; Secret values are length and NUL checked and never Debugged or Serialized.

Per-media states are Pending when intent has no receipt and Complete with name, byte_len and sha256 only after file length, non-empty and hash checks pass; mismatched receipt name is Corrupt, not Pending.
Recovery status mirrors the journal scan: Clean for intact prefix or Interrupted when a torn suffix was quarantined; quarantined_bytes and records expose exactly what was cut.
Receipt name must equal the original intent name for the same media_id; any rename between intent and published record returns Corrupt and aborts recovery.

Identifiers must be 1..96 bytes starting alnum with only alnum plus _.:-; bounded strings 1..max without NUL; crop width/height nonzero with non-overflowing x+width and y+height; clocks must be decimal strings.

Media file contract: target must pass symlink_metadata without symlink flag, be a regular file, have nonzero length, read without Io error, satisfy Clock(len)==byte_len and sha256_hex==sha256; zero-length or empty read both map to Media failure.

Frame contract: nonempty and <=16384 bytes, schema exactly cafe.operator.v1, kind exactly operator_intent, request_id identifier, ListWindows offset <=1000000, ConfigureFfmpeg sha256 64 lowercase hex, ConfigureObs port nonzero, Twitch channel <=25 lower/digit/_.

If media_root is symlink or not a dir, or a published target is symlink, not a file, zero length, unreadable, length-mismatched or hash-mismatched, recover returns Media or Io and yields no Recovery; unknown record kinds are ignored.

Any extra outer/body field, duplicated JSON key, numeric/leading-zero/negative/overflowing clock, oversized frame, malformed crop overflow, empty secret or embedded host field returns operator_frame_rejected; caller must still check epoch/revision and pins.

User sees previously published media listed as Pending after restart when its receipt is absent, or recovery refuses to start when a file was deleted, truncated or altered, because the receipt can no longer be verified on disk.
User sees CAFE_RUNTIME_BLOCKED:<code> on stderr followed by process exit 1 when runtime startup is denied; no service is started.
User sees operator command ignored with operator_frame_rejected when JSON has an extra field, duplicate op or request_id, numeric clock, bad secret, or oversized frame; no action is taken.

Recovery reuses the journal exclusive open lock that validates the committed prefix and quarantines the torn suffix, so replay observes a stable prefix while interrupted tail bytes are exposed separately.

Hard bounds: operator frame 16384 bytes, secret 1..1024 bytes, capsule/person/token limits inside valid, folder 4096, Twitch 25, request identifiers 96; over-limit input is rejected without allocation of the operation.

Replay depends on authority_journal Journal, Record, JournalError, sha256_hex and Clock plus capsule_registry Snapshot; main wires capsule_registry, authority_journal, recorder_pacer, ffmpeg_recorder, authority_auth, runtime_* and discord_windows/organizer modules.

Symlink traversal is refused at both media_root and each media target via symlink_metadata; secrets expose only via expose() and have no Debug/Serialize, so token material cannot leak into projections or logs.

Bounded proposal holder that drafts recording, stop-all and send-to-OBS plans as observations, expires them after 60s, and records per-window outcomes; it never grants authority or issues confirmations.

Proposal entries: recording needs folder root plus valid folder and measured popouts; stop-all needs 1..12 unique identifiers; send-to-OBS needs obs_ready plus 1..12 unique id/title pairs. All fail when a plan is already pending.
Local operator click path: take_confirmed consumes the pending plan with matching id into Executing, reject discards it as Rejected; wrong id returns plan_unknown and leaves the pending plan visible.

Outcome path: set_window_result records one observed row state per index during Executing and flips to Completed when no row stays pending; plan_result exposes pending_confirmation, rejected, expired or completed, hiding rows unless completed.
Projection exposes only plan_id, window titles, folder_name (empty for stop/send) and expires_unix_ms, or Null when nothing is pending; native handles and generations never leave the PendingPlan.

Selection matches optional operator tokens against window_token serialization of each view handle, then keeps only visible non-minimized Discord popouts; titles are copied into the plan while handles stay frozen for click-time re-resolve.

Lifecycle PendingConfirmation->Executing->Completed plus Rejected and Expired branches. expire flips overdue pending to Expired; ready blocks new inserts with plan_pending and evicts the oldest terminal result past 64 entries.
Auto-anchor starts off and throttles polls to one per second; toggling the flag never resets last_poll nor creates a plan, and a fresh authority always starts disabled.
Folder segment must be 1..64 bytes, start alnum, contain only alnum plus space _ -; paths, traversal, drive prefixes, leading space/_/-, trailing dot, NUL and non-ASCII are rejected.
Capsule, feed and plan identifiers must be 1..96 bytes, start alnum, contain only alnum plus _.:-; duplicates in stop/send lists are rejected as unavailable.

Click-time window must resolve by exact handle plus generation and equal the frozen view in title, geometry, layout and minimized state; incarnation, title, width, layout or minimize change yields window_changed or window_unavailable.

Insert computes deadline now+60s and expires_unix_ms unix_ms+60000, both checked, with expiry capped at 2^53-1; plan_id is organizer-<epoch>-<seq> with checked sequence increment. Overflow returns unavailable without mutation.

Row states are closed to recording, stopped, sent, obs_not_ready, encoder_session_limit, encoder_unavailable, capture_start_unavailable, window_unavailable, window_titles_identical, window_changed, folder_not_authorized, disk_write_failed, capsule_limit, already_recording and unavailable.

If tokens are empty, over 12, duplicated, overlong or NUL-bearing, or selected popouts are empty, token count mismatches, over 12, or share executable/class/title among visible windows, returns no_discord_windows, window_titles_identical or unavailable.
Without folder root returns folder_root_required, bad folder returns folder_name_invalid, no measurable popout returns the select error; projection stays Null on all three.
Empty, duplicated, malformed or over-12 stop lists return unavailable; send additionally needs obs_ready else obs_not_ready, titles <=2048 without NUL, unique ids, else unavailable.
Confirm or reject of an unknown, already consumed, or TTL-expired id returns plan_unknown; expired plans flip to Expired, clear projection, and can never be confirmed afterward.

Row update outside Executing gives plan_unknown, bad index or second write to same row gives unavailable, unknown state string gives unavailable, bad capsule id gives unavailable; Executing rows never surface via plan_result.
User sees a card with plan_id, window titles, folder name and expiry countdown while pending, then the card disappears to Null once confirmed, rejected or expired.

User sees pending_confirmation, then completed with per-window sent/recording/encoder_session_limit rows, or rejected/expired with no rows; during execution the query reports unavailable rather than a partial result.
Single pending slot serializes proposals: every propose and confirm path first expires the current plan, so at most one plan can be pending and result history is bounded without locks.
Bounds are MAX_CAPSULES 12 windows per plan, PLAN_TTL 60s, MAX_PLAN_RESULTS 64 retained results with oldest-terminal eviction, and safe JSON integer cap 2^53-1 on expiry milliseconds.
No durable on setting: construction always starts with auto_anchor false and last_poll None; only an explicit local set_auto_anchor(true) enables the once-per-second poll.

Depends on windows_window_registry WindowRegistry/WindowView for refresh and resolve, discord_windows classify_discord_window for Popout filtering, and capsule_registry Clock for epoch/unix-millisecond math.

Serialized tokens are matching hints only; stable identity is handle plus generation. Titles and raw HWND values are never identity keys, and ambiguous descriptors are reported distinctly from missing windows.

Rust-owned lifecycle for one private Python connector child over bounded anonymous JSONL pipes: monotonic epoch, handshake, validated exchange/lease, restart and owned-child-only teardown with static error codes.

Spawn validates epoch nonzero, launches program plus args with piped stdin/stdout/stderr and kill_on_drop, takes stdio, starts bounded relay channel 8 with stdout reader and stderr drain, then runs handshake before marking available.

Handshake writes connector_start frame for the epoch, waits 5s for one reply, requires a validated connector observation with body ready true; any close, timeout or wrong body fails spawn and stops the child.

Exchange validates one authority frame then writes and returns the validated reply; lease builds a private-sink token frame via lease_frame and requires an effect_result with accepted true, else lease_rejected.

Restart stops the owned child, reserves epoch+1 with checked add before launching so a failed restart still consumes it, then replaces self with a fresh handshake. Stop marks unavailable, closes stdin, kills owned child and aborts relays.
Authority frames flow validate_authority_frame->pipe write->5s read from mpsc relay->validate_connector_frame; token material, child output, argv and OS error text never enter returned codes.
Lease frame construction rejects sink other than private before encoding or writing; the reply carries only accepted boolean, never token bytes.

Availability starts false, becomes true only after handshake, and latches false on child exit, relay close, EOF, timeout, validation failure or I/O error; status reports available, decimal epoch string and owned pid.
Every exchange first checks available and try_wait on the owned child only; any exited child, relay closure, EOF or validation failure closes stdin, marks unavailable and returns a static code.
Kill guard allows signalling only when live pid is Some, greater than 1, not own process id, and exactly equals the spawn-recorded pid; sentinel, self or unknown targets are never signalled.

Spawn contract: epoch must be nonzero else invalid_epoch; stdio missing gives stdio_missing; spawn OS failure gives spawn_failed; handshake timeout gives handshake_timeout, early close gives handshake_closed, non-ready gives handshake_rejected.

Exchange contract: unavailable child gives connector_unavailable, write loss gives exchange_failed, 5s reply wait gives exchange_timeout, bad reply gives its validation code; lease adds lease_rejected when accepted is not true.
If handshake fails after spawn, spawn stops the child and returns handshake_timeout, handshake_closed or handshake_rejected instead of an available supervisor.
On write failure, reply timeout, relay EOF/None/error, or connector validation failure, exchange takes stdin, marks unavailable and returns exchange_failed, exchange_timeout or the validation code.
Restart after stop can fail with epoch_overflow on u64 wrap or the fresh spawn code; the reserved next epoch stays consumed so epochs never repeat (1, failed 2, recovered 3).
User sees connector reported as unavailable with its pid and epoch string after child exit or EOF; further calls immediately fail with connector_unavailable until a restart creates the next epoch.

User sees spawn rejected as handshake_timeout, handshake_closed or handshake_rejected when the child never signals ready, and lease rejected as lease_rejected when the child does not accept; no token or child output appears in the message.

Two detached tasks own the pipes: stdout relay forwards read_frame results over an 8-slot channel and exits on terminal frame, stderr task drains 4KB chunks forever; stop and Drop abort both without touching other processes.
Bounds are mpsc depth 8, stderr buffer 4096, handshake and exchange timeouts 5s each; relay closure is treated as unavailability and stdin is closed on first failure to bound pipe state.

Depends on authority_auth make_frame, read_frame, write_frame, validate_authority_frame, validate_connector_frame and lease_frame for framing and validation; tokio process, mpsc, tasks and timeouts for ownership.
Signal guard prevents killing init (0/1), self (own pid), or a recycled pid by requiring exact match to the recorded spawn pid; status and stop never touch any pid except the owned child handle.

Absolute-deadline selector that buffers at most one source frame and emits at most one contiguous recording slot per select, with checked rational timing from an immutable origin and Arc-shared pixels, never encoding or blocking on pipes.
Bounded preview decimator clocked by recording slot indices that emits index 0 then exactly when the preview tick increases, sharing pixels via Arc and holding only scalar state.

Core sequence: new validates profile and starts index 0 at origin; offer buffers the latest frame; select returns None before deadline, one OutputFrame when due, or a PacerError for late, absent or stalled sources.

Recovery and preview path: skip_late jumps the origin forward past tolerated lateness and returns skipped count; observe maps each recording OutputFrame to emit or decimate without touching Pacer state.

Frames flow offer->CurrentSource with Arc, arrival Instant and source Clock->select checks deadline, lateness and hold->OutputFrame with index, deadline, Arc frame and duplicate flag; only selected frames advance index and counters.

Recording index flows into floor(index*preview_num*record_den/(preview_den*record_num)); first index emits, later indices emit only when tick exceeds last_tick, otherwise one decimation is counted and no frame is retained.

Monotonic slot machine: index starts 0 and increments only on successful select, origin moves only in skip_late, current.selected flips true on first selection so repeats are marked duplicate while keeping indices contiguous.

Preview state is last_index plus last_tick: unset requires index 0, then requires strictly increasing indices; emit updates both plus emitted, decimate updates both plus decimated, with no partial mutation on overflow.
Profile requires nonzero fps_num/den and nonzero lateness/hold budgets plus frame period floor of at least 1ns via 1e9*den/num; sixty_fps binds 60/1 to caller budgets with the same check.

Preview rate must be nonzero, at most 60 FPS via fps_num<=60*fps_den, and at most the recording rate via u128 cross-product preview_num*record_den<=record_num*preview_den; all math is checked with no floating point.

Offer rejects now before origin, now before last arrival, or source_time before current source_time as ClockRegression; replacing an unselected source counts source_replaced once with checked increment.

Select rejects now before origin or arrival as ClockRegression, lateness beyond max_lateness_ns as TooLate, missing source as SourceAbsent, hold beyond max_hold_ns as SourceStalled, and any checked or conversion failure as Overflow.
Observe rejects first index other than 0 and any duplicate or regressing index as ClockRegression, plus arithmetic or counter overflow as Overflow; emit clones the Arc, decimate returns None.

If now passes deadline plus max_lateness, select returns TooLate without advancing; if no frame was offered it returns SourceAbsent; if the buffered frame sat longer than max_hold it returns SourceStalled.
Any clock moving backward across origin, last arrival, source_time or arrival instant returns ClockRegression; counter or deadline arithmetic overflow returns Overflow and leaves state unchanged.
Zero preview rate, over-60 FPS, preview above record rate, or bad record profile returns InvalidProfile; observe of index 0 out of order or repeated index returns ClockRegression.
User sees recording stop after a stall with TooLate or SourceStalled instead of frozen video, or a gap with repeated duplicate frames counted separately when the source is held across slots.
User sees missing or stalled preview when indices skip or regress: observe rejects the sequence with ClockRegression and the caller clears its preview rather than showing a wrong frame.

Live recovery shifts origin forward by skipped*1e9*den/num instead of jumping index, so written slots stay contiguous; late_slots tolerance is max_lateness_ns divided by period, saturated on overflow.

Bounded retention: at most one source frame and no preview frame are held, all sharing via Arc with no copies; counters source_replaced, repeated, selected and emitted/decimated track drops explicitly.
Depends only on capsule_registry Clock for source_time, capture_frame_pool OwnedFrame for pixels and arrival Instant/Duration math; offering never encodes, touches disk or blocks on pipes.

All timeline math uses checked u128 multiply/divide plus u64 try_from and checked Instant add; division denominators are guarded with max(1) or explicit Overflow so zero or wrapped timing cannot fabricate a deadline.

Manages admitted capture batches: owns CapsuleState per capsule plus live CapturePipeline feeds in a BTreeMap. Drives only tick/stop/abort and reads bounded state and counters. Never creates pipelines, tokens, or FFmpeg processes.
new stores parent budgets max_capsules and max_feeds, rejects zero with EngineError::InvalidBudget. No upfront allocation. All IDs are trusted already-checked inputs.
attach_capsule admits one whole capsule batch async. Validates empty, duplicate feed keys, duplicate capsule id, overflow, capacity, and recorder state before inserting as Running with reason None.

On any attach rejection, aborts only the incoming feeds via abort_incoming best-effort cleanup and returns EmptyFeeds, DuplicateFeed, DuplicateCapsule, CapacityExceeded, Overflow, or InvalidPipelineState. Existing recordings untouched.
Attach requires every incoming pipeline recorder_state equals RecordingState::Recording, else InvalidPipelineState. Non-recording pipelines never enter the managed map.
tick_all ticks every feed of every Running capsule with pipeline.tick(registry, now). Skips Interrupted capsules. Returns Ok when all succeed, else Tick(first PipelineError).

First feed failure in a capsule marks it Interrupted with reason from pipeline_reason, aborts every other feed of that capsule, preserves other capsules. First error across capsules returned as EngineError::Tick.
stop_capsule stops feeds in key order via pipeline.stop(journal), collecting RecordingReceipt values. Removes capsule only when every feed stops successfully.

Single feed stop failure marks capsule Interrupted, retains original reason via get_or_insert, aborts remaining feeds, retains batch, returns EngineError::Stop. Never claims partial completion. Unknown id returns NotFound.
abort_all attempts pipeline.abort on every feed of every capsule, marks each Interrupted with default reason recording_interrupted if unset. Caller must call explicitly on shutdown; no Drop logic.
PipelineError::Stopped during abort is treated as already-cleaned cleanup and ignored. Any other first failure returned as EngineError::Abort after all attempts complete.

status returns bounded read-only snapshot sorted by id: capsule ids, CapsuleState, reason, plus per-feed FeedStatus with feed_id, RecordingState, and RecorderCounters. No handles, paths, tokens, or pids.
recording_reason is closed vocabulary: nine listed codes pass through, everything else maps to recording_interrupted. Unknown adapter text never escapes to state, logs, or MCP.

pipeline_reason maps Source to capture_source_unavailable, WriteFailed/DiskFull to disk_write_failed, InvalidPath to folder_not_authorized, BlockedEncoder/Spawn to encoder_unavailable, else recording_interrupted. ChildExit is not session exhaustion.
CapsuleState has Running and Interrupted only. Transitions: insert as Running, tick failure to Interrupted, stop failure to Interrupted, abort_all to Interrupted. No transition back to Running.

User sees recording stop with reason disk_write_failed, folder_not_authorized, encoder_unavailable, capture_source_unavailable, or recording_interrupted; tick/stop/abort surfaces tick failed, stop failed, abort failed with debug cause. Rejected starts show duplicate, capacity exceeded, count overflow, or capsule not found.
Capacity checked with checked_add for feed total and capsule count to avoid overflow; exceeding max_capsules or max_feeds rejects with CapacityExceeded. Overflow of counters rejects with Overflow.

All drive methods are async and sequential over cloned key lists; tick stops at first feed failure per capsule, stop aborts feeds after the failing index. Abort errors ignored with let _ except aggregated first cause.

Depends on CapturePipeline<S:FrameSource>, PipelineError, RecorderError/RecorderCounters/RecordingReceipt/RecordingState, WindowRegistry, and Journal for stop publication. Parent owns admission and validation.

Single authority owner loop: opens storage, journal, broker, registries, RuntimeEffects, organizer, services, FFmpeg selection, then multiplexes stdin, broker, actor effects, service completions, ticks, and snapshots until stdin disconnect.
input spawns stdin line thread into sync_channel(8) with MAX_OPERATOR_BYTES cutoff; output spawns stdout writer thread via Projection publish with Condvar. Publish drops payloads over 32768 bytes.

mutate handles local operator intents: epoch check, stale_revision except query, seen-request dedup, then Snapshot, OrganizerPlanConfirm/Reject, SetAutoAnchor, ListWindows, CreateCapsule, PairWindow, SetFolder, Start/Stop/SendToObs, ConfigureFfmpeg/Obs/Twitch.

organizer_request handles remote broker data-only requests: OrganizerStatus, ListDiscordWindows, ProposeRecordingPlan, PlanResult, ProposeStopAll, ProposeSendToObs. Enforces size, schema cafe.organizer.v1, opaque request_id, epoch match, and liveness.

Control flows stdin decode_operator to mutate, broker requests_rx to organizer_request, effects_rx ActorControlJob to execute_effect with frozen organizer window, services.drain completions to complete_from_actor. Changed flag triggers snapshot publish.

Organizer plans move pending proposal to take_confirmed then per-window Record/Stop/Obs effects tracked in effects map keyed by sha256 id, results set via result with closed codes, failures map holds capsule to static reason.
window_page pages registry snapshots in fixed triples: skip offset, take 3, next offset if more. organizer_windows reuses pages and rejects total over 256 with unavailable rather than truncating.
opaque_id requires non-empty up to 96 chars, first char alphanumeric, rest alphanumeric or _.:-. Used for broker request ids and OBS capsule id lists with uniqueness and MAX_CAPSULES bound.

OBS selection requires bound capsules only, feed count equals binding count, unique roles, resolved layout match, and exactly one visible non-minimized window per title/class/executable. Else no_discord_windows, window_unavailable, or window_titles_identical.

anchor_classified only reuses exact one-game-feed capsules, fails busy with already_recording, reserves new organizer-epoch-slot ids, repairs crop/layout via RemoveFeed plus pair_observed when idle. Non-Popout classification rejected.

Internal prepare/build codes map to closed public reasons: encoder_unavailable, capture_start_unavailable, window_unavailable; failure_code maps to recording_* categories, unknown or canary-suffixed codes to recording_setup_failed. Never leaks paths or child output.

Start validates epoch, enumeration, frozen window Popout, capsule/bindings match, layout match; prepare_feed then build_feed with ticks; any failure sets failure reason and returns Interrupted. Stop failure records engine reason. OBS failure sets obs_not_ready or window codes.

User sees JSON states rejected/blocked/pending/observed/committed/interrupted with codes like window_titles_identical, capsule_limit, encoder_unavailable, folder_not_authorized, projection_budget_exceeded. Oversized snapshots collapse to projection_unavailable.

Bounded projections: snapshot over 30000 bytes replaced, broker responses over 16000 replaced with unavailable, projection channel capped at 32768, operator bytes capped by MAX_OPERATOR_BYTES. Window pages of 3, OBS discovery cap 256.

with_recording_ticks polls future with 5ms timeout and ticks engine between polls so recordings stay live during slow hardware trials. Main loop drains up to 4 inputs, 8 broker requests, 1 effect per iteration plus 5ms sleep.

startup_ffmpeg reads CAFE_RUNTIME_ROOT, CAFE_FFMPEG_PATH, CAFE_FFMPEG_SHA256, CAFE_FFMPEG_STARTUP_BLOCKED. No defaults preserve manual setup as observed/authority_started; incomplete or unapproved values yield blocked/ffmpeg_startup_selection_blocked.

Depends on Organizer, PairingBook bindings filtered by capsule snapshot generation/role, WindowRegistry/NativeAdapter, ControlRuntime journal, RuntimeEffects engine, ExternalFfmpeg preflight, ServiceClient OBS/chat. MAX_CAPSULES twelve enforced natively.

Pairing and authority errors expose only static categories like pair_window_unavailable or pair_authority_rejected; payloads and canary strings never escape. Remote schema denies unknown fields and cannot carry confirm, folder, or configure ops.
Owned runtime construction: hardware preflight, native observed capture, bounded crop copies, and existing recorder start. No renderer-supplied argv; approval re-verified by hash on disk.

select validates absolute non-parent path, 64 lowercase hex digest, rejects symlinks including Windows reparse bit, streams file in 64KiB chunks to compare SHA256. Returns approval with no preferred encoder yet.
encoder_ready true only after successful hardware trial for this approval. Not evidence another concurrent session can start.

prepare_feed checks crop pool limits, builds 60fps profile, reuses cached verified preflight via with_profile across feeds and sizes, else tries Nvenc/Amf/Qsv in preferred order. BlockedAudit clears cache and returns ffmpeg_audit_blocked.
hardware_candidates orders preferred hardware first, never includes Ffv1 software fallback. Each of Nvenc, Amf, Qsv appears exactly once.

build_feed validates Windows only, effect_id charset and length, resolves window, checks layout_revision, starts NativeCapture with observed pool and stall budget, waits 3s for first frame, trims crop, verifies crop pixels, starts Recorder with late recovery and preview.

First-frame wait maps Waiting/Healthy to continue, Minimized/Frozen/Closed/DeviceLost/ResizeRequired/GenerationMismatch/Backpressure/BorderUnavailable/SourceFailed/ClockRegression to capture_* codes, timeout to capture_first_frame_timeout. Failure stops capture.

Recorder start maps InvalidPath to folder_not_authorized, WriteFailed/DiskFull to disk_write_failed, BlockedEncoder to encoder_unavailable, all else including ChildExit to recorder_start_failed. No invented session-limit evidence.

RecordingSource retains first observed frame, then takes native latest, copies bounded crop via pool.copy_from with stride arithmetic and source clock preserved. Crop failure sets failed flag and yields None.

crop_frame rejects zero sizes, x+width or y+height overflow or beyond frame, and start offset outside pixels with observed_crop_outside_frame or observed_crop_overflow. Pool exhaustion maps to crop_pool_exhausted.
resolve_recording_crop trims only full-window bindings to content size when content smaller than window; user crops fitting content preserved verbatim; missing or invalid content returns requested.
observed_pool_limits rejects zero, over 3840x2160, zero slots, or width*height*4 overflow with crop_resource_bound. Small windows keep exact geometry, no 4K reservation.
RecordingSource state returns SourceFailed once crop failed, else capture.poll_state. stop drops retained first frame then stops native capture.
Profiles fixed at 60/1 fps, queue 32, write 2s, stop 8s, max lateness 100ms, max hold 3600s. Capture pool 8 slots, crop pool 36 slots; four 1080p feeds total 1459814400 bytes under 2GiB bound.

User sees still window repeating last frame, not failure; closure or minimizing fails start with window or capture codes; tampered binary invalidates cached preflight and blocks hardware with encoder errors.

Cached preflight shared via RefCell across feeds; tamper detected on reuse clears preferred encoder and cache. Trace stages mark encoder_preflight_begin/ok, capture_begin/started, first_frame_wait/ready, recorder_begin/ready, capture_failed.

Depends on NativeCapture start_observed, FramePool copy_from, HealthPolicy stall budget 36e9, Recorder start_ready with RecordingPlan media/intent/publish events, Journal durability, and WindowRegistry resolution.

Operator binary never executed without digest match and link checks; no system binary substitution or software codec fallback. Tampered file after caching fails re-verification and never reuses trial.

Owns the private Python service child for the authority. Verifies pinned runtime resources, spawns ConnectorSupervisor with epoch-bound frames, tracks last accepted state, and exposes obs/chat readiness.
Depends on authority_auth make_frame plus validate_authority_frame for epoch-bound frames, on ConnectorSupervisor for spawn exchange restart stop, and on pinned python.exe plus connectors directory.

Pins runtime-manifest schema cafe.private-python.v1, version 3.13.16+20261013, archive 21987516 bytes, PYTHON_ARCHIVE and WEBSOCKETS_WHEEL hashes, websockets 17.2, and required python executables and connector sources.

No symlinks allowed on any ancestor; on Windows also rejects reparse points. Only Component::Normal names accepted, rejects empty, backslash, colon, NUL, traversal; exact canonical path must equal joined path and be a file.

Reads only regular files under root, rejects files over 8 MiB, parses JSON, callers check schema fields. Errors are static strings service_manifest_rejected or service_resource_rejected, never details.

Requires 64-char lowercase hex pin, opens only regular path, limits size to 64 MiB, optionally checks exact byte count, streams 64 KiB chunks through SHA-256 and compares hex digest. Any mismatch returns service_pin_rejected.

Requires absolute symlink-free root, canonicalizes, validates manifest schema version archive bytes hashes, walks files plus websockets files with count <=16384 and total <=384 MiB, requires three python principals, validates cafe-build sources and .py connector pins.

Production entry is packaged(): derives resources from current exe parent/parent, calls Program::at, stores Program as Option. ServiceOwner::packaged never fails; configurable() false means unavailable without error.

Args are -I -B -c BOOTSTRAP plus connectors dir and service root. ensure() reuses live child when status available, else restarts or spawns ConnectorSupervisor with python path, args, epoch; child held as Option.

Validates local authority frame, ensures child, checks child authority_epoch parses as u64, exchanges service_request frame. On exchange error or kind != service_result, clears body, stops child, returns service_exchange_failed or service_reply_rejected.

Enforces accepted-state coupling: configure_obs accepted requires obs==configured; start_chat accepted requires chat==running. Otherwise clears body, stops child, returns service_reply_rejected. Returns Ok only when accepted true else service_operation_rejected.

private_python_unavailable when no Program; service_start_failed on spawn; service_restart_failed on restart; service_epoch_rejected on unparsable epoch; service_unavailable when child missing after ensure.

Background task loops try_recv work queue depth 8, performs owner.request serially, forwards State then Done updates. reserve() caps 8 pending keys, rejects duplicates and finished task; submit inserts pending key then sends Work.

drain() polls up to 16 updates, tracks state changes, completes pending keys; on channel closed or task finished clears state and fails all pending. close() signals stop with 12s timeout then aborts; Drop aborts task immediately.

User sees OBS never shows configured or chat never connects despite retries. Code returns configurable false, obs_ready false, chat_ready false because body missing or closed true or messages not a positive numeric string.
poll() no-ops when no child or under 1s since last poll; sends status op and reports changed flag. close() sends close op only when available, then stops child and clears body unconditionally.
Test-only temp dirs use pid plus atomic counter; explicit traversal names ../ /sample C:sample backslash empty rejected. Hash and byte-count mismatches and Program::at on bare dir fail closed.
Selects and exclusively leases host-supplied private storage. Creates root, session, recordings, chat directories with owner-only permissions and derives a random nonzero epoch as session id.

Enforces owner-only Windows DACLs for persistent runtime directories: builds protected SDDL O:SID D:P with full access for owner only, creates directory with it, and verifies owner plus exact ACE list.

Entry is open(requested). Root comes only from native Electron host, never renderer or MCP. Existing root is verified, missing root is created private, then canonicalized before lease and session creation.

Rejects any symlink ancestor and on Windows reparse points; rejects non-directories. On Linux requires uid equal to /proc/self owner and mode with no group/other bits; on Windows delegates to DACL verify.

Rejects non-absolute paths, any ParentDir component, or linked ancestors with runtime_directory_rejected. Lease path is rejected if linked; writer must be a regular file; try_lock failure returns authority_already_running.

verify or create root, canonicalize, open authority.lock mode 0o600, lock exclusively, sample entropy for 8-byte big-endian epoch nonzero, create session-epoch plus recordings plus chat with exclusive create. Retained sessions persist; lockfile never deleted.

runtime_epoch_rejected when epoch zero; runtime_entropy_unavailable when entropy fails; collision on retained session name fails exclusive create so epoch is never reused. Second open while live fails with authority_already_running.

Holds _writer File for process lifetime to retain exclusive lease; dropping first storage keeps authority.lock file and prior session dir. Recordings, chat, session paths are subdirectories of canonical root.

Desired SDDL is O:SID D:P with one full-access owner ACE. Comparison requires same owner, leading P flag, only optional AI/AR flags, and exact ACE substring match; inheritance bookkeeping alone never passes.

Embedded NUL in path rejected. Create failures return runtime_directory_create_failed; descriptor conversion failures return runtime_acl_unavailable; ownership or DACL mismatch returns runtime_acl_rejected.

Windows owner SID comes from authority_auth::windows_auth::owner_sid. Windows builds require windows crate security and filesystem APIs; Linux path uses uid and mode bits; other platforms return runtime_platform_unsupported.

User sees app refuses to start or second instance exits saying another instance is running. Happens when authority.lock is held, root is group/world accessible, a symlink is present, or requested path is relative.
Tests prove exclusive lease blocks second open, journal file stays readable, lockfile survives drop with new epoch, and 0o755 roots are rejected on Unix. Scratch dirs use pid plus atomic counter.
Creates a private Windows rendezvous for the control broker: owner-only directory, local-only named pipe cafe-broker-nonce, and broker.pipe metadata with schema, pipe name, and authority pid.

rendezvous(dir,nonce) creates the first pipe instance and directory; next_instance(nonce) creates additional instances with first_pipe_instance false so follow-on MCP clients cannot be mistaken for a fresh owned name.

Derives owner SID from current process token via OpenProcessToken plus GetTokenInformation TokenUser and ConvertSidToStringSidW. Fails with rendezvous_owner_failed on empty or over-64KiB token info or conversion failure.

SDDL is O:SID D:P with one full-access owner-only inheritable ACE. Pipes use max 4 instances and reject_remote_clients true. Directory and broker.pipe are created with the same explicit descriptor, not inherited defaults.

Nonce must be exactly 64 ASCII hex chars else rendezvous_nonce_failed. Directory path with interior NUL rejected. Metadata file uses CREATE_NEW so existing file fails; pipe address is local \\pipe\cafe-broker-nonce form.

Encodes metadata JSON schema cafe.rendezvous.endpoint.v1 with pipe_name and authority_pid, writes it once to dir/broker.pipe with GENERIC_WRITE and FILE_SHARE_READ. Any failure removes broker.pipe and the directory before returning.

ACL build failure returns rendezvous_acl_failed; directory failure rendezvous_create_failed; pipe bind failure rendezvous_bind_failed; metadata encode rendezvous_encode_failed; metadata write rendezvous_write_failed.

RAII closes token handles and frees SID and descriptor buffers via LocalFree. Descriptor and attributes must outlive CreateNamedPipeW inside Tokio; file handle from CREATE_NEW transfers once into File.

First instance claims the name with first_pipe_instance true to prevent impersonation; later instances join with false. No discovery of foreign names; each call binds one server instance for one client.

User sees broker never appears or client cannot connect to local pipe. Code returns rendezvous_nonce_failed, rendezvous_bind_failed, or rendezvous_create_failed when nonce malformed, name already owned, or directory ACL denied.
Windows-only module using windows crate for token, SID, DACL, directory, CreateFileW, and Tokio named-pipe server. No secret values logged; errors are sanitized static codes or owned strings.
Elevated tokens with default owner Administrators still get explicit owner-only descriptor on directory and metadata, since inherited DACLs lack protected flag and explicit owner.

Implements Direct Windows Graphics Capture source: creates D3D11 device, free-threaded frame pool, capture session, staging texture, and frame/closed handlers that copy pixels into a bounded recorder-owned FramePool under CaptureHealth.

Preferred entry start_observed samples identity-checked item size then delegates to start with resolved dimensions. resolve_size rejects zero, oversized, pool-exceeding, zero-slot, zero stall budget, or zero access timeout with Geometry.

All sizes and budgets are caller input; no production defaults. start rejects zero dims and dims over i32::MAX; start_observed dimensions come from native item, never window bounds; initial item size must equal config exactly.

Frame callback validates device, permit, ContentSize, SystemRelativeTime, QPC time, surface texture format B8G8R8A8 Count 1 and exact dims, CopyResource to staging, Map read, copy_from pool, Close frame, re-check permit, admit_frame then publish latest.

take_latest and poll_state re-check permit and registry identity on every call; failed check drops cached pixels and maps Unavailable to Minimized, StaleWindow to Closed, else SourceFailed. poll_state stamps fresh QPC time into health status.
WinRT apartment initialized multithreaded per start; RoUninitialize runs only when RoInitialize succeeded. Init failure including conflicting apartment mode fails closed before any native allocation.
Every callback path releases borrowed resources: FrameCloseGuard closes capture frame, MapGuard unmaps staging texture. Borrowed frame, surface, texture, and mapped pointer never escape handle_frame.

Callback-shared state is Arc Mutex holding health, latest, pool, permit, device, context, staging, baseline. Callbacks never hold WGC event sources, avoiding reference cycles; shutdown drops handlers before locking for Closed.

borderless false leaves OS indicator untouched as Required. True requires session cast to IGraphicsCaptureSession3, Borderless access Allowed within caller access_timeout_ms, plus SetIsBorderRequired false verified by getter; else Border or Timeout.
stop/shutdown removes FrameArrived and Closed tokens, closes session and pool, clears latest, publishes Closed. Idempotent; never holds shared lock while waiting on callbacks. Drop calls shutdown.
Typed sanitized errors only: Unsupported, Unavailable, Window, Geometry, Device, Pool, Health, Border, Clock, Timeout. No native identifiers, pointers, or OS-localized strings leak.

Device-removed clears latest and emits DeviceLost; permit failure emits permit_failed and identity mapping; content resize emits content_resize plus Resized; pool exhausted emits pool_failed plus Backpressure; health reject emits health_rejected.
Depends on WindowRegistry capture_permit and item, FramePool copy_from, CaptureHealth admit_frame plus admit_content_size, QPC clock, D3D11 device with BGRA support, and WGC session/pool/item APIs.

Caller supplies width, height, pool limits max_width max_height max_frame_bytes slots, health policy stall budget, borderless flag, access_timeout_ms. ACCESS_POLL_QUANTUM 5ms only sets grant notice promptness, not the bounding budget.

Optional stderr trace via OnceLock sync_channel 32 and cafe-trace thread. Stages allowlisted; over 255 events or send backpressure records native_trace_limit once. Lossy by design; writer appends CAFE_TRACE lines.
Monotonic QPC clock scaled by u128 into 100-ns Clock units; never copies source timestamps. Negative counter, nonpositive frequency, or overflow returns Clock error and health SourceFailed.
GetDeviceRemovedReason error means DeviceLost; empty-queue polls never count. Other failures map to SourceFailed. True only for genuine device removal.

User sees recording stop after a few frames with empty preview or frozen image. Capture moves to Closed, Minimized, or failed health after device loss, minimized window, stale identity, resize, or backpressure; take_latest returns None.

Single-slot pools free superseded latest lease before copy so replacement cannot deadlock. Async border wait uses Tokio sleep_until capped at deadline because windows-future 0.3.2 exposes status only via public .0 field.

Provides safe NTFS metadata policy for journal publication: verify parent is NTFS and publish via same-volume write-through move without replace. Successful flushes plus journaling, not a directory-fsync claim.
Call require_ntfs_directory(parent) before publishing. Opens read-only handle with BACKUP_SEMANTICS, checks is_dir, queries volume filesystem name, requires case-insensitive NTFS.
Read-only directory handle is never flushed. Returns JournalError::Io when open, metadata, volume query, UTF-16 decode, or terminator scan fails, when not a directory, or when name is not NTFS.

Publishes source to target with MoveFileExW MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH only. No COPY_ALLOWED or REPLACE_EXISTING: same-volume operation, never clobbers existing target. Embedded NUL in either path returns Io.
Encodes source and target as NUL-terminated UTF-16 vectors valid for the call, then moves atomically with write-through. Caller must have flushed file data first; this covers metadata journaling.
Cross-volume move, existing target, missing source, or non-NTFS volume fails with JournalError::Io. No partial replace occurs because replace flag is absent.
Windows-only, depends on windows crate filesystem and volume APIs plus authority_journal::JournalError. Unsafe confined to this module with live handle and buffer lifetime comments.
User sees journal or recording metadata not persisted after crash or power loss on non-NTFS volumes. Code refuses to publish there with an I/O error rather than risk torn metadata.
Power-loss qualification still pending on real Windows hardware. Option (b) semantics: checked file flushes plus NTFS journaling plus write-through move, explicitly not a directory flush guarantee.
Owns window identity: maps native or fixture observations to stable WindowHandle plus generation and layout_revision, so capture and preview can reject recycled HWNDs and stale crops.

Fixtures enter via refresh_fixtures; native windows via NativeAdapter::new(epoch) plus enumerate(registry). Preview and capture read via resolve, preview_source_id, live_preview_source_id, capture_permit.

Sorts observations, rejects duplicate keys, validates witness birth pid executable class rect and slot. Same witness birth pid executable class reuses handle and generation, bumps layout on rect or layout change; else allocates next handle window-epoch-next and layout 1.

Finds entry by exact handle plus generation else StaleWindow. Hidden or minimized returns Unavailable. Requires exactly one visible unminimized window sharing executable class title else AmbiguousDescriptor.
Caller-observed call-layout change bumps layout_revision by one, invalidating earlier crop approvals. Unknown handle returns StaleWindow; counter overflow returns IdentityExhausted.

Per-HWND lifetime cookie stored as window property Cafe.WindowLifetime.epoch plus owned map; reuses only when property matches owned. Re-verifies IsWindow, pid equality, and cookie after reads; mismatch is NativeFailure.

EnumWindows collects up to 4096 HWNDs, overflow aborts. collect_eligible skips hidden/minimized pre-check, observes cookie birth pid executable title class rect, re-checks visibility and cookie, then reconcile publishes only eligible windows.

Capture candidate requires visible true and minimized false. Ineligible returns Ok None and is dropped. Per-window NativeFailure is skipped without hiding others; only IdentityExhausted aborts the whole enumeration.

Preview grants no pairing or capture authority and never synthesizes HWND. preview_source_id returns window:raw:0 only for Native keys with exact generation and layout. live re-observes witness, title, class, rect, visibility before projecting.

Unsupported on non-Windows enumerate and fixture capture; InvalidDescriptor on zero witness birth pid, empty executable class slot, or zero rect; DuplicateObservation on repeated keys; StaleWindow on unknown or recycled identity.

WitnessStore Drop removes only its owned properties from live windows. Synthetic fixture owns class and window on its thread, removes adapter property and destroys window plus unregisters class on cleanup.

Fixture spawns named thread cafe-capture-fixture with 5s start and close waits, 10ms pump loop with PeekMessage plus InvalidateRect for fresh frames. WM_CLOSE is swallowed so only owner-thread cleanup destroys it.

Registry-owned capability keeps raw key private. capture_permit builds GraphicsCaptureItem via interop CreateForWindow then checks. check verifies IsWindow, visibility, pid, cookie, process birth with double reads; stale gives StaleWindow, hidden gives Unavailable.

Resolves handle, looks up Native raw key, verifies witness before and after CreateForWindow, checks visible and not minimized both times. Fixture keys return Unsupported; recycled witnesses return StaleWindow.

User sees window missing from picker, pairing rejected as ambiguous, or capture stops when window minimized. Code returns Unavailable, AmbiguousDescriptor, or StaleWindow instead of showing stale pixels.
Fixture tokens never project to native source ids; duplicated descriptors suppress preview. Minimized windows are excluded then restored as fresh identity, never reusing the old handle.

Non-Windows adapter is Unsupported stub. Windows path depends on windows crate for enumeration, window text class rect, process birth image name, capture interop, and Tokio named-pipe independent rendezvous.
Fail-closed local admission ledger for shared-host work: computes how many lanes may run from memory, load, peer usage and writer count, and persists admitted counts atomically.

CLI main(action,count,--writer,--watch) with CAMP env; actions status/request/release/set/recover-legacy/recover; request/set/release rejected with use_recorded_capped_runner_not_anonymous_counts; else delegates to memory_policy.

transact locks ledger, reads own lanes/writers, reads peer lanes via read_other, samples mem/load via measure, derives limit via capacity, then optionally atomic_write and returns admitted/free/capacity dict.

Ledger schema cafe.lanes.v1 with live lanes and writers; request grows live if admitted, set replaces live if admitted, release clamps live/writers down, status only reads; admitted=false leaves ledger unchanged.
writers must never exceed live; violation raises corrupt_writer_count. live and writers are natural numbers; schema must equal cafe.lanes.v1 else corrupt_own_ledger.
natural accepts only type int and value>=0, else raises invalid_count. Rejects bool-like or float counts; callers transact and capacity rely on it for live, writers, other_live.

capacity requires finite non-negative available_gib/load1/load5 else invalid_measurement; limit=min(24,40-other-8,floor(available-20-1.5*writers)); forced 0 when available<25, load1>16, load5>20, stopped, or writers>6.
read_other expects JSON with dict lanes of natural values; any OSError/ValueError/KeyError/TypeError returns fallback (40,True) marking peer data reserved/unavailable rather than failing open.
If schema mismatch raises corrupt_own_ledger; if writers>live raises corrupt_writer_count; both abort without write and propagate to caller. No partial admission persisted.
measure reads /proc/meminfo MemAvailable and os.getloadavg; missing row causes StopIteration, missing file OSError; main maps these to admission_unavailable with capacity 0 and exit 75.
On OSError/ValueError/TypeError/KeyError/StopIteration main prints {admitted:false,capacity:0,error:admission_unavailable} and exits 75. Missing CAMP or watch evidence triggers same fail-closed path.

User sees admission refused or lanes stuck at 0: fail-closed output admitted false, capacity 0, error admission_unavailable. Overload (low memory, high load, too many writers, stopped flag) yields limit 0 without error text.

locked creates parent dirs and holds exclusive flock on sibling .lock file (fcntl on POSIX, msvcrt LK_LOCK elsewhere) across read-modify-write; transact and main recovery hold it to serialize ledger updates.
atomic_write stages JSON via mkstemp in target dir, fsyncs file and parent directory on POSIX, then os.replace; cleans temp on failure. measure derives GiB from MemAvailable kB; no caching.
CAMP env locates LANES_CAFE.json and LINK_QUEUE.json; link_hold returns true when LINK_QUEUE.json schema cafe.link-queue.v1 has rollbacks_since_green>=2, used by memory_policy admission_hold.
Depends on memory_policy for read_state/recover_dead/save/application_memory/recover_legacy; legacy v1 transact path is shadowed because main rejects request/release/set before reaching it.
Serialize verified patches as queued units and leave commit windows for the operator; agents apply and test but never commit or push, operator commits reviewed diffs.

CLI --repo --camp with subcommands append/list/apply-next/window; append needs unit/surface/patch/evidence/message; list dumps queue; failures print {status:error,reason:link_queue_precondition_or_gate_failed} exit 1.

append validates slug/message, binds patch bytes to PASS evidence sha and reviewed preimages, snapshots current files, checks overlap/parking, stores patch under out/link/patches and appends queued row.

apply_next checks PARADA.txt LIBRE, retires committed rows, picks admissible queued unit, verifies patch hash and preimages, git apply, runs full_gate runner, on fail restores backups and marks failed, on pass marks linked with postimages.
Unit status queued->linked->committed-by-operator, or queued->failed; linked may gain window number. window_due true when >=4 linked-without-window or oldest linked_at older than 90 minutes.
LINK_QUEUE.json schema must be cafe.link-queue.v1 with list units and dict reds; rollbacks_since_green must be non-bool int>=0 else corrupt_link_queue. window_due recomputed on lock entry and exit.

retire_committed only flips linked to committed-by-operator when HEAD content digests match postimages plus window_shared_postimages, deletions proven absent via cat-file, and worktree unchanged; git errors leave row untouched.

safe_path rejects empty, backslash, colon, NUL, absolute, dot/dotdot components, leading .git/local/node_modules/target/_scratch/_target, secrets (.env*, operator/launch token, auth.json, *.key), symlinked parents, and paths escaping repo.
patch_paths rejects git-apply summaries with modes 120000/160000 or rename/copy, non-numeric numstat rows (binary/rename), empty or duplicate file lists; returns sorted safe names only.

append requires SLUG unit/surface, single-line non-empty message, evidence verdict PASS with patch_sha256 equal to patch bytes, and proof preimages exactly equal to current snapshots; duplicate unit, overlapping queued paths, parked surface (>=2 reds), or existing stored patch rejected.

Gate runner must return int not bool else gate_result_invalid; any runner exception restores backups, marks failed/unavailable, increments surface reds and rollbacks_since_green, persists queue, then re-raises.

apply_next refuses when operator window commit pending, no admissible queued unit, queued patch changed, preimage changed, PARADA not LIBRE, or git apply --check fails. window refuses when pending window, no linked units, or linked files changed.

Operator sees apply-next exit 1 with status failed or error reason link_queue_precondition_or_gate_failed; patch rolled back, unit marked failed, surface red count grows, window blocked until operator commits.
locked resolves camp strictly, holds exclusive flock on link_queue.lock, validates queue, yields mutable state, then rewrites window_due and persists via atomic_json temp-file plus os.replace.

full_gate requires explicit absolute node dir with node binary, approved sprint python at out/P15/deps/venv/bin/python, runs run_capped build timeout 900 tools/run_ci.py with isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR/HOME; writes gate.stdout/stderr per unit and demands 8 named pass stages.

window writes out/link/window_N.md with ordered git add/commit commands for owned paths then one shared generated-metadata commit, plus verify_clean_clone and push; assigns window number and per-row code/shared path sets.

Depends on git apply/show/cat-file, sha256 digests, file modes via stat; snapshot requires existing path be regular non-symlink file, None means absent; restore resets bytes and mode or unlinks created files.

Only SHARED_GENERATED catalogue/router paths may overlap linked units; any other overlap is rejected as overlapping_uncommitted_unit_paths. Shared overlap still requires current preimages in PASS evidence to avoid stale metadata.
Second immutable link profile: reuses link_queue v1 implementation but additionally treats catalogue/coordinates.jsonl as shared generated metadata allowed to overlap linked units.
Owned-scope declared-memory admission with durable recovery evidence: admits leases only with proven cgroup scope, memory caps, and budget/headroom checks, persisting to LANES_CAFE.json v2.
One admission card per owned worker: validates job/brief, rejects dated/PID text in brief, then execs run_capped muse lane and launches campaign launch_muse.sh under the granted lease.
main delegates argv to wrapped link_queue.main; import fails fast with RuntimeError base_link_tool_version_changed if base file sha256 differs from EXPECTED_BASE_SHA256 pin.

Args job, brief, wall default 1500; job must match cf_[A-Za-z0-9_]+, wall positive int and brief an existing file; CAFE_CAPPED_ACTIVE unset execs run_capped --kind muse, else verifies lease then runs worker.

Base tool version pinned by exact sha256 4e97f38a...; any edit to link_queue.py breaks import instead of silently changing overlap semantics. ORIGINAL_SHARED preserves v1 set before adding coordinates file.
high_limit sets MemoryHigh to 3/4 of memory_max rounded down to page size; systemd_argv rejects leases whose memory_high or swap (must be 0) mismatch, or scope/id naming mismatch.

read_state requires existing LANES_CAFE.json under 1MiB, schema cafe.lanes.v2, dict leases and list history; each lease needs id==key, scope run-cafe-<hex32>.scope, memory_max int in 1..16GiB, else explicit errors.

reserve validates memory_max, samples load/mem, locks ledger, reads state, recovers dead leases, checks M0/hold/PARADA/link_hold/peer/load/writer-count/budget gates, then mints uuid lease with owner pid/start/boot/order and saves.

Recovered when same boot and pid start mismatch absent or reused, or prior boot; live active/activating/deactivating scopes are kept and charged, inactive/failed removed with history event recovered_dead_lease.

Rejects with M0_not_approved for non-sentinel/m0 before approval, admission_hold when hold/PARADA/link_hold, L1_admission_rejected on peer/load/writer/count, declared_memory_budget_exceeded on BUDGET 40GiB or headroom formula.

Only converts exact v1 {lanes:1,writers:1} with recorded wave cafe job cf_s1_g4d_write_w1 evidence whose pid is now absent; archives raw bytes to out/M0/legacy_lanes_v1.json and mints empty v2 state, else legacy errors.

release no-ops when key absent; else requires owner pid/start match, polls scope up to 21x50ms for inactive/failed, raises scope_state_unavailable on unknown state and scope_still_live on timeout, then appends released history.
User sees worker refused to start with M0/admission/budget errors, or brief rejected exit 67 when it contains PID-like or date text; interrupted lane exits 143 after waiting for owned launcher.

All mutations hold cafe_lanes.locked on LANES_CAFE.json, recompute lanes/writers from leases on save, and recover dead leases before admission; application_memory sums Desktop and Chromium cgroup memory.current without modifying cgroups.

Global BUDGET 40GiB; per-lease cap 16GiB; admission also requires total <= (available-20-1.5*writers)GiB for non-sentinel. Desktop glob app-gnome-chatgpt required, bridge glob optional; missing desktop raises desktop_memory_unavailable.

Identity rests on /proc pid start field 22, boot_id file, and systemctl show scope LoadState/ActiveState/MemoryMax/High/SwapMax; stop_owned verifies description and limits before systemctl stop, returns False when already inactive.

Worker must prove cgroup path ends with its scope under newton-ia.slice and kernel memory.max/high/swap match lease, else worker_scope_mismatch; muse_lane forbids graphical OBRERO_VIA escape and bare bash resolution via BASH path.
Execute one leased command under an owned systemd scope with declared memory caps; no unbounded fallback or detached escape, always releasing the lease afterwards.
Create an isolated writer checkout from the last fetched origin/main revision as a detached worktree with external target dirs and a recorded worktree.json receipt.

CLI --kind gate/build/clone/muse/argon/judge/preparation/electron/m0, --memory-gib, --writer, --inside ID, --verify-active ID, command after --; CAMP required; verify-active only checks current lease and exits 0.

unit.sh <lowercase-slug> matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$; resolves repo and CAMP, refuses existing wt-<slug>, re-execs via run_capped preparation when CAFE_CAPPED_ACTIVE unset, else verifies lease and builds worktree.

run_capped reads local/sprint.json settings, picks default GiB by kind (16 muse/argon/judge, 10 build/clone/electron, 6 others), reserves lease, re-invokes itself --inside with systemd-run argv, finally releases lease.

Embedded python validates camp/repo/worktree root external and non-symlink, fetches origin main, resolves origin/main^{commit}, mkdirs out/worktrees/<slug>, adds detached worktree at revision, writes worktree.json with base and CARGO paths.
--inside registers worker pid/start, sets CAFE_CAPPED_ACTIVE and OBRERO_VIA=directo, then execvps the command replacing the process. Empty command after parsing is a parser error, not silent success.

Slug, worktree root, and revision strictly validated: fetched revision must match [0-9a-f]{40,64}; worktree root must be external to repo, not symlink; existing destination or state dir aborts with worktree_already_exists/unit_state_exists.

Lease lifecycle reserve -> systemd scope start -> --inside register_worker -> command exec -> release; verify-active and inside transitions require matching lease key; any failure still attempts release via finally.
On OSError/ValueError/KeyError/SubprocessError prints {status:blocked,reason:capped_admission_or_execution_failed} to stderr and exits 75. Failed reserve or scope start never runs the inner command.
Exits 2 on bad slug/args, 1 on worktree_already_exists or unsafe/external-path violations; python stage raises on invalid revision or worktree add failure, removing empty state dir on add exception.
User sees blocked JSON on stderr with exit 75 when admission or spawn fails, or worktree_already_exists when retrying a slug; no worker starts and no partial checkout is left as active.
Single lease per invocation serialized by memory_policy ledger lock; systemd-run --scope --slice=newton-ia.slice owns exactly one run-cafe-<id>.scope; no respawn or retry loop after failure.
Memory caps come from --memory-gib or kind defaults times GIB; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and DBUS address defaulted for user bus; CARGO_TARGET_DIR/HOME isolated under camp out dirs for writer builds.

CAMP must name existing campaign dir; CAFE_PYTHON selects interpreter; CAFE_CAPPED_ACTIVE carries admitted lease id; CAFE_WORKTREE_ROOT overrides default <repo>-wt parent; CAFE_UNIT_* pass repo/slug/worktree into python.

Depends on memory_policy reserve/register/verify/release/systemd_argv, systemctl/systemd-run user scopes, and git fetch/rev-parse/worktree add; graphical dispatch escape explicitly disabled via OBRERO_VIA.

Worktree parent resolved and checked against repo containment and symlink before creation; destination checked before and after resolve to close TOCTOU on wt-<slug>; intermediate commits guidance lives in link window, not here.
Host-owned boundary owning one native authority child over anonymous JSONL pipes, exposing a closed origin-checked IPC surface with no renderer-controlled spawn or lifecycle.

IPC handle(caller,method,payload) authorizes origin/frame/mainFrame then dispatches getSnapshot or submitIntent; unknown method throws. subscribe(caller,listener) authorizes and emits sanitized projection immediately.
start is idempotent for supervisor lifetime: at most one spawn with stdio pipe triple and shell false; spawn throw or invalid result marks backend spawn failed and returns unavailable status.

submitIntent validates closed envelope keys/schema/kind/ids/clocks, matches epoch/revision, enforces body object and hostSelection gate for configure_ffmpeg/set_folder, JSON-encodes line, then bounded stdin queue with backpressure.
