Stdout bytes accumulate in pendingBytes, split on newline via drainPendingLines with incremental maxLineBytes enforcement, UTF-8+JSON decoded per line, then snapshot/delta applied; stderr only counts bytes.

Valid snapshot sets epoch/revision/state and flips to available; same-epoch backward revision marks stale snapshot unavailable. Delta requires available, exact epoch/base and revision=base+1, else stale delta unavailable.
First failure wins: reason never overwritten, queued intents cleared, projection otherwise frozen; availability starting/available/unavailable, pid set once, stderrBytes monotonic.
Clocks are canonical u64 decimal strings without leading zeros in 0..18446744073709551615, never JS numbers; envelope key sets exact via hasExactKeys; state deep-cloned and frozen before exposure.
Caller must be object with exact authorizedOrigin, frame identical to getAuthorizedFrame(), isMainFrame true; any mismatch throws unauthorized IPC caller/origin/frame before touching backend.
Renderer projection strips preview_sources from state copy; host onStatus keeps full status. Listeners run in snapshot order, individual listener throw cannot break others.

Non-Uint8 chunk, empty line, non-UTF8/JSON line, malformed envelope, unknown kind, invalid snapshot/delta keys/clocks/state, stdout error/end, stderr error, stdin drain/write/error, child error/exit/close each map to a distinct unavailable reason.
Line exceeding maxLineBytes (default 4096) or buffered incomplete line beyond limit sets stdoutFailed, drops buffer, and marks stdout line exceeds byte limit; no further stdout lines processed.

Renderer sees availability unavailable with reason like backend child exited, stdout protocol violation, stale delta, or intent queue capacity exceeded; intents then throw backend unavailable until fresh snapshot.

stdin.write false enters waitingDrain without resending accepted chunk; later drain flushes queued lines in order; dispose kills only owned live child with pid checks and clears listeners, safe twice.
Defaults maxLineBytes 4096, maxQueueBytes 16384 with maxQueue>=maxLine+1; no respawn after EOF/error/exit/dispose; write queue bounded by writableLength+queued+new bytes, excess throws backpressure.

Control schema cafe.operator.v1, kind operator_intent, default command cafe-core; host injects spawn, command, args, authorizedOrigin, getAuthorizedFrame, limits, onStderr/onStatus/onIntent observers.
Child handle must expose stdout/stderr/stdin on plus kill; host provides EventSource/StdinAdapter; supervisor never imports platform or renderer modules, all validation runtime before use.
Host file-selection ops configure_ffmpeg/set_folder require hostSelection true; renderer submitIntent cannot set it, preventing renderer-driven file picker intents from entering the queue.
Single-use short-lived window preview grants for main frame only; source identities never leave main and renderer serializes each grant and getDisplayMedia acquisition.
request(event,payload) needs IPC event with sender/mainFrame, exact capsule_id/feed_id identifiers, enabled true, installed and not disposed; races or busy/acquiring states refuse with preview_busy.

binding maps capsule/feed to one preview_sources row plus one capsule and feed with positive generation, epoch from available authority status; requires windows platform, authority_ready, <=24 rows, source_id window:N:0.
Grant lifecycle candidate->pending->acquiring->consumed; pending cleared when stale; displayRequest consumes pending once, acquiring cleared in finally; dispose clears both and blocks new grants.
Grant stays current only while enabled, unexpired (GRANT_MS 5000), installed, same live BOOT_URL main frame, and binding still yields identical source_id/generation/epoch; else treated as absent.

Identifiers trimmed 1..96 chars matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,95}; clocks trimmed non-zero leading digits <=u64max. Payloads need exact keys capsule_id,feed_id; BOOT_URL cafe://app/bootstrap and ORIGIN cafe://app gate frames.

media permission opens only with live grant for same frame, requestingUrl BOOT_URL, empty mediaTypes array; typed camera/mic requests stay denied. permissionCheck needs app origin and undefined mediaType.

Denials return frozen {ok:false,error} with preview_denied/disabled/unavailable/busy or no_preview; source enumeration raced 3s timeout maps to preview_unavailable; malformed display request finishes with null streams.

displayRequest requires pending grant, same frame, app origin, videoRequested true audioRequested false, and exactly one enumerated source matching source_id; else callback null without consuming another document grant.

User sees no live preview tile or picker: request resolves no_preview/preview_busy/preview_unavailable and display handler supplies no stream; validated on real Windows only, stays disabled elsewhere.
requesting flag serializes enumeration; pending single grant plus acquiring single consumption prevent double-acquire; 3s timer cleared in finally; immediate listener errors cannot break subscribe.
DesktopCapturer queried windows-only with zero thumbnail and no icons; grant expiry 5000ms host clock injectable via now for deterministic tests; enumeration result filtered by exact id equality.

Host-only enabled constant gates all grants; no renderer flag can enable. install attaches setDisplayMediaRequestHandler with useSystemPicker false once; missing function or disposed leaves uninstalled.

Depends on host getContents/getStatus/getSources injections, Electron session/desktopCapturer, main-frame URL and detached/parent checks; recording itself stays in Rust core, this module display-only.
Only the exact DesktopCapturerSource object from this enumeration enters Electron; no audio, system picker, or renderer-selected id accepted, preventing grant theft across documents.
Host-only user FFmpeg selection check: never a download, bundled default, or license claim; Rust preflight still approves the exact encoder and production policy.

verifyFfmpegSelection(config) expects {ffmpeg_binary:{path,sha256}}; returns frozen {file,sha256,bytes} or throws FFMPEG_SELECTION_BLOCKED. resolveDefaultFfmpeg(env) returns first matching candidate or null.

Path must be absolute, normalized, NUL-free, canonical via realpathSync equality, no symlink on file or any parent, opened O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW; size 1..512MiB; sha hex 64 chars must match streamed hash.
Ordered candidates: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Cafe\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe then each machine PATH dir joined with ffmpeg.exe; trims/quotes PATH parts, picks win32 joiner for drive/backslash paths.
Opens fd, fstats before, streams 1MiB chunks counting total, fstats after; rejects when total!=before.size, mtime/ctime changed, hash mismatch, or read beyond initial size; closes fd in finally.

Any shape, symlink, size, hash, TOCTOU, or fs error collapses to single error FFMPEG_SELECTION_BLOCKED with no reason detail; fd always closed. resolveDefaultFfmpeg swallows per-candidate failures and continues.
User sees manual FFmpeg selection required: resolver returns null when no candidate exists, is symlinked, or hash differs from DEFAULT_FFMPEG_SHA256 pin, leaving startup to prompt for audited exe.

Probe is stateless ordered first-match: each candidate verified independently with pinned hash c6caa189...; absent/symlinked/wrong-hash skipped, first pass wins, none yields null without side effects.
Approved default hash pinned to c6caa1894d3276556c84b36acc1d219d69f972c0a7525b23f1cad2bdf05c4231; default path never enters renderer state and never auto-downloads on mismatch.
No shared state; fd-local streaming with before/after stat guards concurrent replacement during hash; parent-dir symlink walk is not atomic with open, so post-open fstat guards file swap.
1MiB read buffer, files up to 512MiB hashed whole; fd opened read-only and closed in finally even on throw; no bytes retained beyond returned frozen file/sha/bytes triple.
Reads LOCALAPPDATA and PATH/Path from injected env defaulting to process.env; delimiter ; when win32 or semicolon present else path.delimiter; empty dirs skipped after trim and quote strip.

Depends only on node:fs/path/crypto; uses realpathSync.native, lstatSync, fstatSync, readSync; no network, no registry, no bundled binary; caller runtimeBackend maps failure to CAFE_FFMPEG_STARTUP_BLOCKED.
Strict canonical-path and no-symlink-anywhere rule blocks junction/alias escapes; O_NOFOLLOW may be 0 on some platforms so lstat and parent walk remain load-bearing, not redundant.
Secure Electron boot shell owning single-instance gate, pre-ready sandbox hooks, one hardened window, and at most one main-owned backend; policy lives in security module, this orders calls.

createDesktopShell(electronApi,{preloadPath,createBackend}) quits and returns secondary controller when single-instance lock fails; else asserts launch, enables sandbox, registers cafe scheme, waits ready, builds window.

Loads renderer bundle, installs bootstrap protocol, hardens session with previews, binds native IPC with FFmpeg/folder pickers, creates backend once, shows window on ready-to-show, binds snapshots on did-finish-load.

Controller frozen with secondary flag, bound getWindow/dispose. Shell states disposed flag, currentWin nullable, backend nullable, defaultFolderAttempted/userChoseFolder/choosingFolder; window-all-closed quits, activate recreates.
getWindow returns null when disposed, missing, or destroyed; getAuthorizedFrame returns stable unboundFrame until real mainFrame exists, which native IPC admission then rejects for lack of window.

Preload defaults to dist/preload/index.cjs under app path; createBackend called at most once with authorizedOrigin cafe://app; backend.start before window show; boot failure disposes and throws bootRejected.

Any exception during backend/window creation disposes subscriptions/window/handlers/backend and rethrows; folder/ffmpeg picker cancellations return null without throwing; default-folder errors swallowed to keep manual flow.

User sees second instance quit immediately, blank window with unavailable snapshot on bind failure, or no auto recording folder when Videos/Cafe creation or intent submission fails; app quits on all windows closed.
dispose idempotent: clears backend subscription, nulls window, disposes previews, removes IPC handlers, disposes backend once; bindBackendSnapshots skips re-subscribe when frame unchanged.
At most one BrowserWindow and one backend; subscriptionFrame tracks bound mainFrame; default folder attempted once per shell lifetime guarded by defaultFolderAttempted and choosingFolder flags.

Packaged browser entry requires electron process.type browser, builds backend via runtimeBackend.createPackagedBackend with resourcesPath and runtimeRoot under userData/authority; failure quits app with exitCode 1.

Depends on node:path/fs, shellSecurity for launch/protocol/options/IPC/snapshots, rendererAssets bundle, runtimeBackend packaged factory; folder default uses app.getPath videos plus lstat/realpath symlink checks.

Default set_folder intent uses fixed request_id default-folder with latest epoch/revision re-read before submit and skips when folder already configured; symlink/canonical checks prevent directory-escape default folder.
Host-owned immutable bytes for the two reviewed renderer resources (renderer.js/css) loaded only from fixed packaged filenames with manifest hash verification.
Host-only factory for the single packaged authority child: verifies build receipt and binary hash, builds minimal env, wires FFmpeg selection, trace sink, and supervised spawn.
admitsResource(url,bundle) true only for exact cafe://app/renderer.js or renderer.css with a loaded bundle; rendererResponse returns typed Response or throws RENDERER_RESOURCE_REJECTED.
selectExternalFfmpeg(file) takes native dialog path only, validates regular file up to 512MiB with no symlinks, returns {path,sha256}; renderer input never accepted.

tools/ci_support.py provides portable CI contracts and explicit prepared-inventory metadata with no tree discovery: canonical JSON, hashing, inventory validation, tree and profile digests, tool lookup, sandboxed command execution, and sanitized environment construction.

Tester sees an explicit fail-closed ValueError invalid_prepared_inventory or prepared_inventory_absent and the gate stops before running anything, because the supplied file list is unsorted, duplicated, unsafe, missing, or symlinked.

Tester sees empty_or_duplicate_ci_profile or required_tool_unavailable, or a profile/tree digest mismatch that blocks CI verify, caused by duplicate gate commands, malformed workflow JSON, missing lockfiles, or absent tool on PATH.

validate_inventory rejects when names is not a sorted unique non-empty string list, or any entry has absolute path, backslash, colon, NUL, leading ignored root, dot segments, .env prefix, token or auth names, .key suffix, failed resolve identity, or non-file; it raises ValueError invalid_prepared_inventory.

prepared_inventory runs git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z when .git exists, else reads CAFE_PREPARED_INVENTORY_JSON; absent variable raises prepared_inventory_absent and invalid JSON or failed validation raises invalid_prepared_inventory; no fallback tree walk exists.

Entry is prepared_inventory(root) returning a validated explicit name list, validate_inventory(root,names) enforcing the contract, and tree_digest(root,names) revalidating then hashing each file; callers supply root and explicit names, never a discovered tree.

Entry is executable(name) resolving a tool via shutil.which or raising required_tool_unavailable, and command(argv,root,env,timeout) coercing argv to strings, wrapping Windows .cmd/.bat via COMSPEC, and delegating to run_owned.

source_environment builds a dict from os.environ with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, CARGO_NET_OFFLINE, and CAFE_PREPARED_INVENTORY_JSON set, plus router, policy, Python, Node, Rust, and cache keys removed; that dict plus root and argv flow into command and then run_owned, which returns argv, rc, stdout, stderr.

Inventory source has two exclusive states: git-present uses git ls-files output, git-absent uses CAFE_PREPARED_INVENTORY_JSON; both converge on validate_inventory, so there is no mixed or discovered state and no silent fallback.
Names stay sorted, unique, relative, symlink-free with resolve equality, and outside IGNORED_ROOTS; canonical_json always uses sort_keys with compact separators so digests are stable across machines.
tree_digest hashes each entry as name bytes plus NUL plus sha256 of file bytes, in sorted order; any byte, name, order, or membership change alters the digest.
profile_digest binds commands from ci_profile plus sha256 of the workflow file, package-lock, Cargo lock, and requirements-ci; changing a gate command or pinned input changes the digest.

command is a synchronous blocking subprocess with default 900s timeout and no retry, lock, or background execution; Windows batch files are re-executed through COMSPEC /d /s /c with list2cmdline quoting.

Resources are one git ls-files subprocess, file reads for digests and workflow, PATH lookup via shutil.which, and one owned child process per command; lifetimes end when the subprocess returns and no handles are retained.

Single-threaded syntactic pass with no threads, imports execution, retries, or timers; compile is used only for context-sensitive SyntaxError, never for code execution.

User sees JSON ci-run status fail and the pipeline stops after the first failing stage; a skipped, empty, or version-drifted suite appears as fail rather than silent pass.
Asyncio serves one loopback peer on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port while producer child runs via to_thread; handshake uses 5s recv timeouts and 30s child timeouts, then MCP child runs 15s guarded.

Each run uses isolated temp dirs (cafe-ci-rust, cafe-data-e2e) with CARGO_TARGET_DIR redirected and 900s default child timeout; MCP stdout capped at 131072 bytes and producer files at 4096/16384 bytes.
No compiler or package install occurs; source env comes from prepared_inventory plus source_environment; stage selection is only via --stage flag.

Time oracles derive bucket/summary math from received_at UTC strings via calendar.timegm; clock skew or malformed timestamps fail the e2e rather than producing approximate pass.

Run real gitleaks negative controls with redaction checks; a missing binary is pending, never pass, and nothing is downloaded; purpose is first for this file.

Probe CLI accepts --assess to publish availability assessment; prints cafe.wgc-probe-controller.v1, appends GITHUB_OUTPUT and STEP_SUMMARY when present.

validate_result parses probe stdout JSON {status,reason,profile,frames,clocks}, checks identity regex, u64 clock shape, and (rc,status) pairing before returning data.

For three synthetic secrets, writes credential.txt in fresh temp case dir, runs gitleaks detect --no-git with repo .gitleaks.toml, then asserts rc 1, JSON report exists, findings non-empty, secret absent from outputs.
Report starts fail with null build/test/counts; build_rc then test_rc fill in; status becomes pass only on rc 0, exactly one Ran N>0, plain OK, no FAILED/ERROR markers, and temp dir gone.

Signal target must be the known Popen object with unchanged pid distinct from self and >1; on posix its pgid and sid must still equal pid or ValueError signal_target_not_owned_session.
Gitleaks version stdout stripped of leading v must equal 8.18.4; every case must yield findings with CLI and saved report fully redacted of the planted secret.

Builds cafe-wgc-synthetic offline locked with isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR; missing binary yields fail probe_binary_missing; protocol violation yields fail probe_protocol_invalid.

Build failure records build_rc and echoes output to stderr without running tests; missing binary raises test_authority_binary_absent; any OSError/ValueError sets error integration_gate_unavailable_or_failed.
Any execute exception collapses to {status:fail,reason:probe_unavailable_or_failed}; fail exits 1, not_available exits 0 with --assess else 78, pass exits 0.
User sees JSON fail or pending plus nonzero exit when cargo, probe hardware, or gitleaks binary is absent; gate also prints raw test output to stderr for diagnosis.
One owned child at a time with 900s default timeout; on timeout or error sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL to owned pgid/pid with 5s reaps; never signals ambient processes.
Each tool owns an isolated TemporaryDirectory (integration, wgc-probe, secret-controls); gate sets CARGO_TARGET_DIR and TMPDIR inside it; cleanup flag is owned.exists() check.

Fail before a certificate when observed cargo/rustc versions differ from the pinned profile version; purpose is first for this file.

Clone CLI defaults to create_receipt but --verify-receipt only checks; prints cafe.clean-clone-check.v1 JSON and exits 0 on pass else 1 with pending reason when git or clone is unready.
Toolchain CLI requires --expected X.Y.Z, calls verify, prints cafe.toolchain-check.v1 pass/blocked and exits 0 only on pass.
wait polls executeJavaScript up to 300x30ms for snapshot or DOM predicates (revision 1/3/4, folder Configured, theme) and throws UI_SMOKE_STATE_TIMEOUT on expiry.

Receipt flow: head+inventory+digests form expected receipt, clean HEAD check, git clone --no-local, clone digest and run_profile gate comparison, rewrite receipt only if source unchanged during clone.
Runs cargo --version and rustc --version via runner, regex-extracts X.Y.Z tokens, compares both to expected, returning per-program observed values and pass/blocked status.
Manual revision chain asserted 0->1 (first capsule) ->3 (folder commit) ->reload stays 3 ->4 (second capsule); authority pid must be valid and identical across reload with starts==1.

Renderer contract requires bridge keys getSnapshot,onSnapshot,submitIntent, no OpenAI/MetaViewer/Terminal text, no Sohne/Signifier/Inter font, Start button enabled, non-empty capture, differing dark/light backgrounds.
Stored cafe-clean-clone.json must deep-equal recomputed {schema,head,tree_sha256,ci_profile_sha256,mode:real-git-clone,linux_ci_status:pass} or raises stale/invalid receipt error.
HEAD must exist as 40 lowercase hex via rev-parse --verify HEAD; .git absence yields literal_clean_clone_pending_no_git and missing commit yields pending_no_commit.
Expected must fully match X.Y.Z; observed parsed only on rc 0 plus strict program-name prefix match; any mismatch yields blocked rather than fail.

Env, pid, renderer, theme, or duplicate-authority violations throw UI_SMOKE_ENV_REJECTED, UI_AUTHORITY_PID_INVALID, UI_RENDERER_CONTRACT_REJECTED, UI_THEME_UNCHANGED; child catch logs UI_CHILD_SMOKE_FAILED exit 1.

Dirty tree, tracked-vs-prepared mismatch, clone revision/tree mismatch, real clone CI non-pass, or mid-clone change raise commit/tree/mismatch/gate errors collapsing to pending receipt-required status.
User sees UI_SMOKE_FAILED or JSON {status:pending/fail,blocked} with nonzero exit when Xvfb/Electron, clean clone gate, or pinned cargo/rustc is unavailable or mismatched.
Single synchronous xvfb-run spawn with maxBuffer 1MB and 120s timeout; stdout/stderr plus status/signal recorded to out dir; temp fixture removed in finally even on failure.
Parent keeps Linux temp root short via /tmp fallback for socket paths with 0700 dirs; clone test uses TemporaryDirectory repo copy plus provisioned node_modules, verifying removal implicitly.
Offline Windows RC build contract producing unsigned native-pending manifest; missing prerequisites are blocked, never silent success; purpose is first for this file.

CLI main handles --verify-manifest, --preflight-only, or full build requiring source,commit,python,python-archive,websockets-wheel,electron-cache,output; prints cafe.windows.rc-build.v1 and exits 0 or 2.

preflight(source,commit,python,archive) enforces Windows x64, tool presence, reviewed commit, clean checkout, Rust 1.97.0 plus MSVC target/linker, node 24, approved python archive/exe, node cache, inventory bounds.
invoke runs argv in cwd with CARGO_NET_OFFLINE and npm offline flags, 30s default timeout; OSError maps to COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE and nonzero rc to COMMAND_FAILED showing first three basenames.

Build flow: new external output dir, preflight inventory, cargo release cafe-core for TARGET, npm preload/renderer/check, node build_windows_app.js via temp request file, shell-archive check, manifest write.
inspect_zip streams every ZIP entry hashing sha256, rejecting >20000 entries, encrypted, duplicate casefold, symlink, oversize (>2GiB total or >512MiB entry), or size mismatch rows sorted by path.
Terminal statuses: preflight_pass, built_unsigned_native_pending, manifest_verified exit 0; blocked with fixed code plus required_command exits 2; BUILD_REJECTED covers unexpected OSError/ValueError.
Paths must be absolute without .., UNC prefix, symlinks, or reparse points (0x400 attr), canonical via resolve strict equality; directories checked for every ancestor.
Manifest and inventory names must be strict posix relative: str type, no backslash/colon/NUL, PurePosixPath-stable, no empty/dot/dotdot segments, no leading slash.

Manifest must equal {schema:cafe.windows.rc-manifest.v1,version:0.1.0-rc.1,target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc,windows_verification:pending,files,archive_files} with sorted unique casefold rows and exact artifact set.
Typed manifest verified against disk: each files row size+sha must match local artifact and archive_files must deep-equal live inspect_zip of cafe-0.1.0-rc.1.zip.
Pins: TARGET x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, rust 1.97.0, commit 40 hex, python 3.13.16, archive PYTHON_SHA 7aba3985 with 21987516 bytes, node v24, inventory 1..4096 entries.

Each prerequisite raises Blocked(code,command) with fixed codes WINDOWS_REQUIRED, TOOLCHAIN_MISSING, REVIEWED_COMMIT_MISMATCH, CLEAN_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED, RUST_PIN_REQUIRED, MSVC_LINKER_REQUIRED, and similar.

Build aborts with AUTHORITY_BINARY_MISSING, PACKAGE_NOT_VERIFIED, LOCKFILE_CHANGED, CHECKOUT_CHANGED_DURING_BUILD if exe absent, packager status differs, or Cargo/package locks or HEAD shift mid-build.
Operator sees JSON {status:blocked,code,required_command} with exit 2 naming the exact remedial command such as Get-Command link.exe or git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal.
All toolchain steps run serially with per-call timeouts (15-30s, 900s for cargo/npm/package); no parallel builds or retries; request file is unlinked in finally after packager call.
Creates only new external output dir outside checkout; target dir removed in finally; manifest limited to 8MiB on verify; zip scan caps entries and bytes to bound memory and disk.
Seven build args plus --preflight-only/--verify-manifest; python archive and exe, websockets wheel, electron cache, and output must all be absolute canonical local paths, output new and external.
Depends on git, rustup 1.97.0 cargo/rustc, MSVC link.exe, node/npm 24, approved CPython 3.13.16 archive, tools/build_windows_app.js, package_windows.py, check_shell_archive.py, Cargo/package locks.
Result stays windows_verification pending and built_unsigned_native_pending; manifest shape pins that flag so a local build can never be mistaken for Windows-verified release evidence.

App.vue is the presentation-only workspace shell. It binds the parent controller facade to capsule, window, recording, OBS and chat regions, adopting authoritative snapshots as-is and never inventing capsules, feeds, recordings, progress, errors or ids.

Entry is onMounted reading the closed window.cafe facade via cafeFacade, then createControls(facade), getState, subscribe, and connect. Without a facade it adopts INITIAL_VIEW and marks first snapshot received.

Snapshots flow facade->controls.subscribe->applyView->view ref and recordingTimer.sync. Outbound intents flow UI handlers->controls.* (createCapsule, pairWindow, startRecording, stopRecording, sendToObs, configureObs, configureTwitch, setAutoAnchor, refreshWindows, chooseFolder).

request(task) wraps every parent-owned promise: increments pendingCount, clears notice, and on rejection sets fixed REQUEST_FAILED. Snapshots own all state; request only drives transient pending indicator.

Availability is starting|available|unavailable derived from snapshot; unknown values collapse to unavailable. isStarting is true until first snapshot or while starting. Grid, buttons and browser gate on availReason and gridAvailable.

Per-capsule action lifecycle: blocked->queued->waitForAuthorityResult->committed/observed/configured or rejected/blocked/interrupted/failed/cancelled/unconfirmed. Serial capsuleQueue preserves order; tilePending and tileResults hold per-id transient state.
Snapshots are never merged or validated: non-object falls back to INITIAL_VIEW. Rendering helpers textOf, cid, capsuleFeeds return fixed fallbacks (Unknown, empty, []) for malformed authority values.

Capsule identity is exact host-issued string: non-empty, trimmed, no whitespace, not all digits. workspaceIds returns [] on any invalid, duplicate, or registry overflow so grid reports invalid instead of partial success.

pairWindow contract carries capsuleId, role, windowToken, windowGeneration, layoutRevision, crop x/y/width/height. Token, generation and revision come only from listedWindow or cached browser row revalidated against live snapshot.

Diagnostics render only 9 allowlisted fields in fixed order (schema, bridge, result_state, result_code, capsule/feed/window counts). Only fixed lowercase codes and non-negative safe integers pass; null is no data, else unknown.

Any failed controller promise sets notice to Request failed; refresh and try again. Failed diagnostics read sets Diagnostics unavailable with empty rows. Raw errors and report objects are never surfaced, logged, stored or serialized.

Creating beyond 12 capsules sets wall-limit note and refuses the request. Pair/start/stop/send handlers silently return when controls null, busy, pending, or guard (startBlock/stopBlock/sendBlock/pairBlock) is non-empty.

Window browser paginates up to 256 pages via observeWindowPage; stale sequence aborts. Selection mismatch, generation drift, or unconfirmed create/pair reply sets failed or selection_stale status plus fixed notice.

User sees fixed banners: Runtime unavailable/starting, Capture needs Windows, Choose output folder/FFmpeg first, Pair a window feed first, Select a listed window, OBS/Chat setup pending, Not recording, No previous/next page. Wall shows Starting Cafe or Capsules unavailable.

Capsule start/stop/remove serialize through one capsuleQueue promise chain; batch start/stop awaits each and pauses on first unconfirmed/cancelled/failed/rejected/blocked/interrupted with Batch paused note.

browserSequence and diagnosticsSeq invalidate stale async work: closed/unmounted reads dropped, sequence mismatch aborts pairing, diagnostics results ignored unless sequence matches. actionAbort cancels authority waits on unmount.

Single shared recordingTimer ticks while any recording Running; synced on every snapshot and disposed on unmount. Unmount aborts controller, closes browser, bumps diagnostics seq, removes renderer listeners only; authority and recording never stopped here.
Theme is local dark|light, dark default via absent data-cafe-theme attribute; unknown values refused. Previews, active page, pair forms, browser crop and pending flags are local UI-only state.

Depends on parent control.js helpers, capsule registry (maxSlots 1000), window catalogue and window queries, Dockview wall, and TopBar/StatusBar kit. Platform windows gating and folder/ffmpeg/OBS/chat readiness come from snapshot booleans.

OBS password is cleared after every submit and never shown. Crop suggestion copies listed window rect as editable defaults; backend owns real check. wtokenText shows opaque tokens; tokens are matched exactly, never parsed or coerced.
capture.js owns display-only preview sessions: one getDisplayMedia stream per capsule feed tile. It never touches recording; lifecycle covers only preview tracks, retry timers and ended listeners.
capture.vue renders one feed tile: video element when live, else placeholder with guidance. It wires IntersectionObserver, ResizeObserver, page visibility and feed identity into the session.
Session starts inert; setBinding({capsule_id,feed_id,generation}) and setVisibility(show,allow) jointly gate acquisition. active() requires not disposed, enabled, visible and non-null binding.

Acquire flow: bridge.previewSource({capsule_id,feed_id}) grant -> getDisplayMedia({audio false, ideal size/fps}) -> single-video-track check -> constrain caps -> onStream + live state. Any mismatch routes to later(reason).

Vue maps props to session: capsuleId/feed_id/generation changes call setBinding; enabled/visible/intersecting/documentVisible/window_state gate setVisibility. Stream callback sets video.srcObject and plays; play rejection forces no_preview preview_denied.

States are live, connecting, no_preview with reasons preview_disabled/denied/busy/unavailable. later() emits no_preview and schedules retry at 500/1500/3000ms unless terminal reason or retry budget exhausted.

Authority window_state overrides session: window_minimized or window_closed forces placeholder (Restore it in Windows / Remove capsule) and suppresses acquisition; video hidden whenever external state present.

Preview caps are clamped: width 1..1920, height 1..1080, frameRate max 15. constrain applies max constraints then verifies actual settings stay within caps and frameRate>0, else throws preview_unavailable.

Grant contract: grant.ok true and capsule_id/feed_id must echo the requested binding; grant.error allowlist maps to reason else preview_denied. Returned stream must have exactly one video track and zero audio tracks.

Missing bridge.previewSource yields preview_disabled. Grant mismatch, timeout, ended track, over-cap settings, or NotAllowedError map to later() reasons; catch maps NotAllowedError/preview_denied to preview_denied else preview_unavailable.

8s acquisition watchdog marks timedOut and emits no_preview preview_unavailable, but keeps queue slot until getDisplayMedia settles so a late grant cannot consume another tile's grant; late captures are stopped and retried.

User sees Connecting preview, No preview, Window minimized, or Window closed tiles with notes (permission unavailable, waiting for approved source, recording can still run). Video stays hidden until live.
All tiles share one acquisitionQueue: each acquire runs via serial() so main-frame grants never interleave. Resize work serializes on resizeQueue; concurrent resize during ended-stream safely no-ops.
Generation counter invalidates in-flight acquires on setBinding/setVisibility/stop. Timers cancelled, acquisition timeouts cleared, stream cleared; stale attempts exit before touching state.

Tracks stopped individually with per-track try/catch; ended listeners removed on clear. dispose() stops, marks disposed, and blocks further onState. Vue unmount disconnects observers, clears resize timer, disposes session, nulls srcObject.
Visibility sources: tile intersecting (threshold 0.01), document.visibilityState, enabled/visible props, external window_state. ResizeObserver debounced 120ms before session.resize recon strain.
Depends on window.cafe.previewSource grant, navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia, and surface clientWidth/Height for limits. Absent getDisplayMedia rejects preview_unavailable immediately.
Initial max/min constraints rejected by getDisplayMedia: code passes ideal values then enforces caps post-capture via applyConstraints, avoiding grant rejection while still bounding 1920x1080/15fps.
control.js holds presentation helpers plus a shared display-only recording timer. Timer starts when a capsule first appears Running and resets when it stops; one interval serves all tiles.
control.vue is the presentational REC/Stop/OBS trigger row. It carries no authority calls; emits record/stop/obs/resolve/remove and parent resolves target via existing helpers.
Timer entry is sync(recordings,now): collects Running capsule_ids, stamps first-seen start time, drops stopped ids, starts interval when non-empty and ticks onTick(now) every intervalMs.
elapsedFor(capsuleId,now) renders now-start via elapsedLabel (BigInt ms->h:mm:ss, up to 20 digits). Missing start returns em dash. App.vue feeds timerTick into elapsedFor for header display.

waitForAuthorityResult subscribes to controls, checks getState immediately, resolves when view.lastResult.requestId matches and state leaves pending, when availability leaves available (unconfirmed), on 8s timeout, or on abort.
waitForProjectedMatch polls a snapshot predicate up to 60x50ms while active() holds, bridging authority-result vs snapshot arrival skew (e.g. created capsule not yet listed).

Tile state priority: Running->recording; closed feed or capture_closed->window_closed; minimized or capture_minimized->window_minimized; Failed/Interrupted/Blocked or non-empty reason->recording_failed; else live/connecting/no_preview from preview map.

Numeric strings validated strictly: elapsed accepts finite >=0 numbers or 1..20 digit strings; plan expiry must match digit pattern with safe-integer now. Out-of-range or malformed yields em dash or null, never NaN.

Result labels are fixed and failure-only: queued/committed/observed/configured show nothing. Conflict, unconfirmed, cancelled, blocked, refused map to actionable sentences; fallback is Refresh diagnostics and try again.
Buttons block when busy or reason text non-empty; defaults block (Runtime unavailable / OBS not ready). REC also blocked while connecting or window_minimized at template level.

Problem line shows failureReason (+result) for recording_failed, result text, Restore it in Windows for minimized, stop reason while recording, or rec reason with inline resolve action. OBS reason reveals only after click attempt.

Click guards re-check disabled flags before emitting, so double-click or race cannot emit while blocked. OBS wrapper click sets obsClicked to reveal reason even when disabled button swallows the event.

User sees Live preview, Connecting preview, Window minimized/closed, No preview, Recording, Recording failed. Failed tiles show reason plus review-setup-and-retry guidance; minimized shows restore hint.
Authority wait cleans up exactly once: settled flag, clearTimeout, unsubscribe, abort-listener removal. Late snapshots after finish are ignored; subscribe exceptions resolve unconfirmed.
Interval created lazily and cleared when no Running ids remain; dispose clears interval and start map. No per-tile intervals; single onTick drives all elapsed displays.
Timer configurable via now() clock and intervalMs (default Date.now, 1000ms); authority wait timeout default 8000ms overridable. Countdown in operator uses planSecondsRemaining with 1s ceil.
control.vue depends only on string props (reasons, state, resolveLabel, failureReason, result) and emits; parent App.vue supplies recordReasonFor/stopReasonFor/obsReasonFor and resolution labels.
Exception messages never displayed: actionResultLabel maps only known state/status/code shapes to fixed text. Unknown shapes fall to generic failure line, avoiding leak of raw errors.
grid.vue is the dockable desktop wall for host-issued capsule ids. It never creates ids, capsules, counts, previews or authority calls; unknown availability renders as unavailable, never zero.
operator.vue presents one AI organizer plan requiring approval: window titles, folder name, expiry countdown, Confirm/Reject. Emits plan_id; authority executes on confirm.
Dockview ready supplies desktopApi; wall subscribes to onDidAddGroup (hide headers) and onDidRemovePanel (restore authoritative panels). Initial reconcile plus arrange builds the grid.

reconcile diffs wanted panel ids vs desktopApi panels: removes extras, adds missing via addPanel with position below/right of grid neighbours, retitles existing. arrange() then co-locates into one group in grid order and sizes tiles.
confirm emits only when not busy and remaining>0; reject emits when not busy. Parent App.vue gates on plan_id match and waits authority result before showing outcome.

Grid state: starting (starting&&!available), unavailable (!available), invalid (bad ids), empty (zero ids), ready. Only ready exposes ids to Dockview; CapsulePanel renders null for ids not currently included.
Plan countdown derives from expires_unix_ms vs 1s tick: null->Expiry unavailable, 0->Expired request new plan, else Expires in Ns. Confirm disabled when busy, null or expired.
Id validator: non-empty trimmed string, no whitespace, not all digits, unique. Any violation collapses whole list to invalid with empty ids, never partial render.
Panel id is capsule:<id>; tab label comes from tabLabels prop (slot-N person) with fallback to raw id. Panels use renderer always, min 160x120; floating groups disabled.
Local panel close never deletes a capsule: onDidRemovePanel re-runs reconcile+arrange on microtask to restore from authoritative ids. Guarded by reconciling flag against re-entrancy.
Expired or unparseable expiry blocks confirm entirely; user must request a new plan. Busy disables both buttons; result string surfaces parent authority outcome.

User sees Starting Cafe, Capsules unavailable, Capsule list unavailable: expected exact unique identifiers, or empty-state Add window plus Discord pop-out guidance. Ready wall shows N / 12 capsules plus Arrange wall.
Re-entrancy guarded by reconciling flag and disposed flag; watchers on joined ids, tabLabels and columns trigger reconcile/arrange. ResizeObserver tracks region width for column/row computation.

Observers and Dockview subscriptions (resize, removePanel, addGroup) disposed on unmount; desktopApi nulled. Layout math: columns clamp 1..4 via ceil(sqrt(n)), rows ceil(n/cols), tile size from api or fallback dims.
Wall geometry is derived, not configured: 2 tiles 2x1, 4 in 2x2, up to 12 in 4x3. Group headers always hidden via hideGroupHeader/hideAllGroupHeaders.
Depends on dockview-vue DockviewVue and workspace.css. Content slots remain parent-owned capsule views; wall owns no verbs. Operator depends on planSecondsRemaining helper.
Validator prop mirrors internal validation; parent pre-admits ids but wall re-validates and refuses to render invalid lists, preventing a malformed id from reaching Dockview panel identity.
registry.js provides stable slot-N display aliases for one authority lifetime. Pure module: no bridge, IPC or MCP; one registry per authority epoch, never reused across epochs.

topbar.vue is the capsule header: slot alias, person label, lifecycle state pill, elapsed timer, Remove button. Presentation-only; slot comes from string prop, never array index; window tokens never accepted.
Create via createRegistry({maxSlots}); default ceiling MAX_SLOTS 1000. assign(ids) in authoritative display order establishes aliases; remove, aliasFor, displayFor, activeIds query afterwards.
assign dedupes preserving order, validates each id, checks next+fresh-1<=max before mutating, then allocates monotonic numbers. Reorder and delete-readd retain aliases; active reflects latest order.
slotText and capsuleText trim-check string props, falling back to unknown. displayState maps only known backend values to friendly text; stateKey collapses unknown to one styling key.

Known states frozen: active, standby, ceded, destroyed, lost, live, connecting, window_minimized, window_closed, no_preview, recording, recording_failed. Anything else renders unknown with dotted style; destroyed/lost use dashed.
Id invariant enforced on every entry point: non-empty trimmed string, no whitespace, not all digits. Violation throws ERR_INVALID_CAPSULE_ID; bad options/ids array shape throws ERR_INVALID_OPTIONS.
Overflow contract: exceeding maxSlots throws ERR_SLOT_OVERFLOW with coded Error, leaving existing aliases untouched. displayFor returns slot-N string or null; aliasFor numeric alias or null.
Remove blocked while busy or while stateKey is recording (title Stop recording before removing). onRemove re-checks before emitting, so disabled clicks never propagate.
Failures throw coded Errors (invalid id/options/overflow). App.vue catches overflow/invalid from assign and blanks workspaceIds, causing grid invalid state rather than partial aliases.

User sees slot-N alias, person name or unknown, state pill (Live preview, Recording, Window minimized/closed, No preview, Recording failed, unknown), elapsed timer or em dash with inactive/active label, and Remove button.
Registry is synchronous with no locks; monotonic next counter only grows. App.vue calls assign inside computed workspaceIds and displayFor per render; overflow caught per evaluation.

Aliases map grows to at most maxSlots entries per lifetime; no eviction. Component-lifetime registry capped at 1000 by App.vue; epoch turnover requires fresh createRegistry, old map garbage-collected.
Only knob is maxSlots: must be safe positive integer, else ERR_INVALID_OPTIONS. Non-object, null or array options rejected outright.

No backend dependency; visual grammar copied from MetaViewer CapsulePanel adapted to existing Cafe CSS variables, system fonts only. Parent supplies slotLabel via registry displayFor and capsuleLabel via person label.
Backend vocabulary never extended locally: unknown states render explicit unknown instead of raw value, preventing invented lifecycle text from leaking into UI or styling keys.

Generic S1 28px telemetry footer. Renders breadcrumb, telemetry metrics, optional layout-saved flag, and shortcut buttons plus a shortcuts dialog. Host supplies all content via props or overrides regions via slots.

Inputs arrive as props crumbs, telemetry, layoutSaved (tri-state null default), shortcuts (default Terminal/~ and Shortcuts/?). Slots breadcrumb, telemetry, layout, shortcuts override each region. Host drives dialog via exposed openShortcuts/closeShortcuts.
Shortcut clicks call activate(item): items with opensDialog open the dialog, others emit shortcut-activate with item.id. Parent wires Terminal action and dialog open from this event.
crumbTone(crumb,index,total) returns explicit crumb.tone else accent for last crumb, dim otherwise. Template maps crumbs to li with key index-label and aria-current=page on last item.
dialog ref boolean bound v-model:visible to CSP Dialog id shell/statusbar/shortcuts-dialog. openShortcuts sets true, closeShortcuts sets false; Close button calls closeShortcuts.

S1Crumb {label, tone dim|strong|accent}; S1TelemetryItem {key,value,live}; S1Shortcut {id,label,kbd,opensDialog}. layoutSaved null/undefined renders no layout region; true shows Layout saved, false Layout unsaved.
Dialog state is boolean closed/open. Transitions only via openShortcuts, closeShortcuts, activate opensDialog branch. No auto-close on shortcut emit; host must act on shortcut-activate.
Last crumb defaults to accent tone; separators / and | and live dot are aria-hidden. Telemetry block renders only when telemetry.length nonzero, so empty array shows nothing.
If shortcut entry lacks opensDialog and host has no shortcut-activate listener, click emits id that nobody receives and nothing happens. No log or fallback; dialog stays closed.
User sees missing layout indicator although layout was saved: layoutSaved left at default null renders no region. Cause is tri-state prop never set by host, not a save failure.
User clicks Shortcuts (?) and no list appears or dialog appears empty: dialog failed to open or shortcuts array empty. Dialog lists current shortcuts plus fixed Command palette Ctrl K row.
Depends on openvue/dialog wrapped by createCspDialog from ../workspace/cspDialog.js and UiButton from ../ui/UiButton.vue. Dialog styling relies on cuk-csp-dialog and design tokens.

unsigned: safe int 0..4294967295. clock: decimal string 1..2^64-1 matching /^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/ and <=MAX_CLOCK. token: nonempty, no NUL, UTF-8 <=128 bytes. Rows copy token/generation/layout_revision/title/exe/rect{w,h}/pageOffset.

States idle/loading/ready/incomplete/unavailable/failed. reset clears to idle. unavailable/starting availability clears to unavailable. Any validation error clears to failed. Cap reached sets incomplete with nextOffset null.

User sees Partial list. Refresh to scan again or empty list after scan: catalogue hit limit cap (incomplete) or validation cleared to failed. Refresh with offset-zero restart is the recovery.

Bounded envelope: at most limit entries (default 256) and 3 windows per page. getState deep-copies entries and rects so callers cannot mutate cache.
OpenVue installed with unstyled:true; no preset or dynamic theme engine. Token adapter tokens.cafe.css must load before cafe.css skin. Host must provide #app element.

User sees Could not complete the window scan. Refresh to try again or Café is not connected. Open the app before scanning: status failed/unavailable from catalogue or query failure, Refresh is the recovery.
User sees The window changed or closed. Select it again: selection went stale (selection_stale). Previously chosen token no longer valid; must pick again.

Refresh button disabled while busy; row buttons disabled while blocked. No internal locking; parent owns busy/status transitions and refresh sequencing.

core/src is the single-authority capture and recording core. It owns broker admission and bounded framing (authority_auth), the append-only SHA-chained journal with media receipts, locks and torn-suffix quarantine (authority_journal) plus deterministic crash recovery (journal_replay). The zero-effect admission kernel (capsule_registry) and trusted Rust-only pairing (capsule_pairing) bind capsule feeds to windows, generations and crops. Capture copies row-pitch sources into a bounded BGRA pool (capture_frame_pool), gates frames by generation, geometry, border and clocks (capture_health), and drives take-admit-pace-pump ticks to a receipt (capture_pipeline). Control gates private-stdin operator syntax (operator_protocol), authenticates broker, operator and organizer intents and dispatches durable effects (control_intents), drafts expiring recording, stop-all and send-to-OBS plans over measured Discord popouts (organizer, discord_windows), and supervises the private Python connector child (python_connector_supervisor). Recording paces slots on absolute deadlines (recorder_pacer), supervises FFmpeg spawn, pipe, decode-validate and publish with pinned binary and encoder policy (ffmpeg_recorder), and manages admitted capsule batches (runtime_effects). runtime_main multiplexes stdin, broker, actor effects, service completions, ticks and snapshots; main is the private-stdin entry. It offers durable control and media facts, admitted pipelines and published .mkv artifacts, and needs loopback broker epoch, locked journal dir, live window registry, approved FFmpeg binary and verified media root.

A tester would see bind_failed, rendezvous failures, capability_denied errors, or status showing host 127.0.0.1, port, epoch and effects count. Failed HMAC simply drops the peer with no authenticated session and no secret disclosure.

A user would see recording or control operations refuse with journal_locked, journal_corrupt, journal_invalid, journal_pending, journal_media or journal_io, or a restart report Interrupted with quarantined bytes. No paths or input excerpts are included in errors.

User sees pairing refused and no recording for that feed: wrong person label, unknown capsule, already-paired role or feed, stale window layout after resize, crop outside window, or stale authority revision requiring retry with fresh snapshot.

User sees an operation refused with a short code such as stale_revision, duplicate_request_id, duplicate_role or generation_mismatch; state is unchanged and caller must retry with a fresh snapshot revision or new request id.

User sees recording stall or frames dropped after a few frames with an empty or short file: pool exhausted because consumers hold OwnedFrames, frame larger than max_frame_bytes, or source stride and slice mismatch from a changed capture size.

User sees a paused, black or never-starting capture: minimized window, unavailable border, frozen duplicate timestamps, stale source beyond budget, or a resize that forces restart before recording can continue.

User sees recording that never starts and stays waiting, a mid-session abort with no file, or stop failing to produce a finished receipt after the window closed, device was lost, recorder errored, or stop was called twice.

User sees start refused until a folder is chosen, folder_not_authorized after moving or symlinking the folder, confirmation_required or expired retries, duplicate request returning the prior receipt, or blocked state demanding recovery after disk write failure.

User sees a Discord window that cannot be selected for capture: unmeasured titles stay Unknown, wrong executable casing variants or path-qualified names are NotDiscord, and conflicting rules collapse to Unknown.

User sees recording that never produces a published .mkv and stop returns an error; staged partial may remain while published file is absent because zero-frame output or decoded frame count not equal to written_frames is rejected as ArtifactInvalid.

User sees live recording abort after a stall or wrong-size frame: pace/admit clear the preview, move to Interrupted, and later stop/interrupt/pump calls fail with State, QueueFull, Pacer or InvalidProfile instead of continuing.

User sees previously published media listed as Pending after restart when its receipt is absent, or recovery refuses to start when a file was deleted, truncated or altered, because the receipt can no longer be verified on disk.
User sees CAFE_RUNTIME_BLOCKED:<code> on stderr followed by process exit 1 when runtime startup is denied; no service is started.
User sees operator command ignored with operator_frame_rejected when JSON has an extra field, duplicate op or request_id, numeric clock, bad secret, or oversized frame; no action is taken.

User sees pending_confirmation, then completed with per-window sent/recording/encoder_session_limit rows, or rejected/expired with no rows; during execution the query reports unavailable rather than a partial result.
User sees connector reported as unavailable with its pid and epoch string after child exit or EOF; further calls immediately fail with connector_unavailable until a restart creates the next epoch.

User sees spawn rejected as handshake_timeout, handshake_closed or handshake_rejected when the child never signals ready, and lease rejected as lease_rejected when the child does not accept; no token or child output appears in the message.
User sees recording stop after a stall with TooLate or SourceStalled instead of frozen video, or a gap with repeated duplicate frames counted separately when the source is held across slots.

User sees recording stop with reason disk_write_failed, folder_not_authorized, encoder_unavailable, capture_source_unavailable, or recording_interrupted; tick/stop/abort surfaces tick failed, stop failed, abort failed with debug cause. Rejected starts show duplicate, capacity exceeded, count overflow, or capsule not found.

User sees JSON states rejected/blocked/pending/observed/committed/interrupted with codes like window_titles_identical, capsule_limit, encoder_unavailable, folder_not_authorized, projection_budget_exceeded. Oversized snapshots collapse to projection_unavailable.

Non-loopback bind or zero epoch fails loopback_only. Entropy, bind, or address failures abort start. Wrong identity, epoch, proof length or HMAC mismatch silently drops the connection without an authenticated peer. One-shot brokers burn the secret after first success.

open takes a separate .lock sidecar lock or fails journal_locked, then scans from offset zero. Short headers or short bodies quarantine as interrupted suffix; bad length complement, zero length, oversize, bad trailer or failed replay aborts journal_corrupt with no side effects.
If request authority_epoch or expected_revision differs from snapshot, propose returns AuthorityRejected stale_pair_proposal with no state change and no envelope emitted.

Every error refuses without handing out a partial lease and without consuming a slot. Exhausted fails closed under load; callers must drop a leased frame or enlarge limits, never expect heap fallback.

Non-increasing source_time sets Frozen and returns Frozen; source more than 1_000_000 ticks ahead of observed_at or older than stall_budget sets Frozen and returns StaleSource. Success records source and arrival and sets Healthy.

Failed admission, any non-waiting unhealthy state, or any recorder admit, pace or pump error stops the source, interrupts the recorder, marks stopped true, and returns Source or Recorder error; pipeline never completes on those paths.

Rejects invalid intents, token-shape and reflection cases, unknown confirmations, binding or expiry mismatches, stale revisions, missing recording folder as Blocked recording_folder_required, and poisoned runtime as Blocked authority_requires_recovery with no dispatch.

Non-allowlisted executables return NotDiscord immediately without consulting patterns. Allowlisted Discord.exe, DiscordPTB.exe and DiscordCanary.exe with no pattern match return Unknown, never Main or Popout.

First feed failure in a capsule marks it Interrupted with reason from pipeline_reason, aborts every other feed of that capsule, preserves other capsules. First error across capsules returned as EngineError::Tick.

Entries are read_frame and write_frame for newline JSON with 5 s deadlines and 16384 byte cap, plus BrokerAuthority start on 127.0.0.1 with nonzero epoch. start_control adds a typed ControlHandler path.

Entries are open, stage_control plus commit or append_control, plus append_service_configuration, append_confirmed_intent/result, append_media_intent and publish_media. Reads are records, recovery_status, interrupted_bytes and snapshot.

Wire entry decode_and_apply rejects payloads longer than MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES with Oversized, deserializes directly into typed Envelope so duplicates and unknown fields fail as Malformed, then runs shared validation and apply.

Broker entry handle validates peer liveness, broker identity and epoch, parses closed cafe.control_intent.v1 JSON within 16384 bytes, and requires a live confirmation token whose identity and fingerprint match and have not expired.

Proposal entries: recording needs folder root plus valid folder and measured popouts; stop-all needs 1..12 unique identifiers; send-to-OBS needs obs_ready plus 1..12 unique id/title pairs. All fail when a plan is already pending.

Spawn validates epoch nonzero, launches program plus args with piped stdin/stdout/stderr and kill_on_drop, takes stdio, starts bounded relay channel 8 with stdout reader and stderr drain, then runs handshake before marking available.

Core sequence: new validates profile and starts index 0 at origin; offer buffers the latest frame; select returns None before deadline, one OutputFrame when due, or a PacerError for late, absent or stalled sources.

Frames flow admit->Pacer.offer->pacer.select->VecDeque queue->mpsc sender->background task write_confirmed_chunks with flush per chunk->ChildStdin->WriteAck channel->accept_write counts written_frames/bytes only after confirmed==bytes.

Control flows stdin decode_operator to mutate, broker requests_rx to organizer_request, effects_rx ActorControlJob to execute_effect with frozen organizer window, services.drain completions to complete_from_actor. Changed flag triggers snapshot publish.

Frame contract: nonempty and <=16384 bytes, schema exactly cafe.operator.v1, kind exactly operator_intent, request_id identifier, ListWindows offset <=1000000, ConfigureFfmpeg sha256 64 lowercase hex, ConfigureObs port nonzero, Twitch channel <=25 lower/digit/_.

Generation contract: new capsule or feed generation must be strictly greater than highest_generation watermark, which then becomes that generation. Role slot is Game or Camera snake_case; one feed per role per capsule.

core/src is Windows-first runtime foundation for private capture/recording. runtime_recording orchestrates feeds: ExternalFfmpeg digest approval, hardware preflight Nvenc/Amf/Qsv with cache, NativeCapture observed start, 3s first-frame wait, bounded crop, Recorder start. windows_graphics_capture provides D3D11/WGC source with FramePool copies, CaptureHealth, QPC clock, border handling. windows_window_registry owns HWND identity with generation/layout_revision, reconcile, permits, preview projection, fixture support. runtime_storage leases exclusive host-supplied root with owner-only perms and epoch session dirs; runtime_windows_security enforces/verifies owner-only SDDL. windows_auth builds owner-only rendezvous dir plus local named-pipe broker.pipe. windows_journal_policy gates NTFS and publishes via write-through no-replace move. runtime_service_owner verifies pinned Python resources and owns ConnectorSupervisor child for obs/chat. Offers validated feeds, identity-safe capture, exclusive storage, secure IPC, durable publish, managed service. Needs host root, Windows APIs, pinned binaries, valid windows/crops.

User sees still window repeating last frame, not failure; closure or minimizing fails start with window or capture codes; tampered binary invalidates cached preflight and blocks hardware with encoder errors.

User sees OBS never shows configured or chat never connects despite retries. Code returns configurable false, obs_ready false, chat_ready false because body missing or closed true or messages not a positive numeric string.

User sees app refuses to start or second instance exits saying another instance is running. Happens when authority.lock is held, root is group/world accessible, a symlink is present, or requested path is relative.

User sees broker never appears or client cannot connect to local pipe. Code returns rendezvous_nonce_failed, rendezvous_bind_failed, or rendezvous_create_failed when nonce malformed, name already owned, or directory ACL denied.
User sees journal or recording metadata not persisted after crash or power loss on non-NTFS volumes. Code refuses to publish there with an I/O error rather than risk torn metadata.

User sees window missing from picker, pairing rejected as ambiguous, or capture stops when window minimized. Code returns Unavailable, AmbiguousDescriptor, or StaleWindow instead of showing stale pixels.

User sees recording stop after a few frames with empty preview or frozen image. Capture moves to Closed, Minimized, or failed health after device loss, minimized window, stale identity, resize, or backpressure; take_latest returns None.

First-frame wait maps Waiting/Healthy to continue, Minimized/Frozen/Closed/DeviceLost/ResizeRequired/GenerationMismatch/Backpressure/BorderUnavailable/SourceFailed/ClockRegression to capture_* codes, timeout to capture_first_frame_timeout. Failure stops capture.

Recorder start maps InvalidPath to folder_not_authorized, WriteFailed/DiskFull to disk_write_failed, BlockedEncoder to encoder_unavailable, all else including ChildExit to recorder_start_failed. No invented session-limit evidence.

private_python_unavailable when no Program; service_start_failed on spawn; service_restart_failed on restart; service_epoch_rejected on unparsable epoch; service_unavailable when child missing after ensure.
poll() no-ops when no child or under 1s since last poll; sends status op and reports changed flag. close() sends close op only when available, then stops child and clears body unconditionally.

runtime_epoch_rejected when epoch zero; runtime_entropy_unavailable when entropy fails; collision on retained session name fails exclusive create so epoch is never reused. Second open while live fails with authority_already_running.

Embedded NUL in path rejected. Create failures return runtime_directory_create_failed; descriptor conversion failures return runtime_acl_unavailable; ownership or DACL mismatch returns runtime_acl_rejected.

ACL build failure returns rendezvous_acl_failed; directory failure rendezvous_create_failed; pipe bind failure rendezvous_bind_failed; metadata encode rendezvous_encode_failed; metadata write rendezvous_write_failed.
Typed sanitized errors only: Unsupported, Unavailable, Window, Geometry, Device, Pool, Health, Border, Clock, Timeout. No native identifiers, pointers, or OS-localized strings leak.

Device-removed clears latest and emits DeviceLost; permit failure emits permit_failed and identity mapping; content resize emits content_resize plus Resized; pool exhausted emits pool_failed plus Backpressure; health reject emits health_rejected.
GetDeviceRemovedReason error means DeviceLost; empty-queue polls never count. Other failures map to SourceFailed. True only for genuine device removal.
Cross-volume move, existing target, missing source, or non-NTFS volume fails with JournalError::Io. No partial replace occurs because replace flag is absent.

Unsupported on non-Windows enumerate and fixture capture; InvalidDescriptor on zero witness birth pid, empty executable class slot, or zero rect; DuplicateObservation on repeated keys; StaleWindow on unknown or recycled identity.

select validates absolute non-parent path, 64 lowercase hex digest, rejects symlinks including Windows reparse bit, streams file in 64KiB chunks to compare SHA256. Returns approval with no preferred encoder yet.

prepare_feed checks crop pool limits, builds 60fps profile, reuses cached verified preflight via with_profile across feeds and sizes, else tries Nvenc/Amf/Qsv in preferred order. BlockedAudit clears cache and returns ffmpeg_audit_blocked.

build_feed validates Windows only, effect_id charset and length, resolves window, checks layout_revision, starts NativeCapture with observed pool and stall budget, waits 3s for first frame, trims crop, verifies crop pixels, starts Recorder with late recovery and preview.

Production entry is packaged(): derives resources from current exe parent/parent, calls Program::at, stores Program as Option. ServiceOwner::packaged never fails; configurable() false means unavailable without error.

Entry is open(requested). Root comes only from native Electron host, never renderer or MCP. Existing root is verified, missing root is created private, then canonicalized before lease and session creation.

rendezvous(dir,nonce) creates the first pipe instance and directory; next_instance(nonce) creates additional instances with first_pipe_instance false so follow-on MCP clients cannot be mistaken for a fresh owned name.
Call require_ntfs_directory(parent) before publishing. Opens read-only handle with BACKUP_SEMANTICS, checks is_dir, queries volume filesystem name, requires case-insensitive NTFS.

Fixtures enter via refresh_fixtures; native windows via NativeAdapter::new(epoch) plus enumerate(registry). Preview and capture read via resolve, preview_source_id, live_preview_source_id, capture_permit.

Preferred entry start_observed samples identity-checked item size then delegates to start with resolved dimensions. resolve_size rejects zero, oversized, pool-exceeding, zero-slot, zero stall budget, or zero access timeout with Geometry.

RecordingSource retains first observed frame, then takes native latest, copies bounded crop via pool.copy_from with stride arithmetic and source clock preserved. Crop failure sets failed flag and yields None.

Args are -I -B -c BOOTSTRAP plus connectors dir and service root. ensure() reuses live child when status available, else restarts or spawns ConnectorSupervisor with python path, args, epoch; child held as Option.

Encodes metadata JSON schema cafe.rendezvous.endpoint.v1 with pipe_name and authority_pid, writes it once to dir/broker.pipe with GENERIC_WRITE and FILE_SHARE_READ. Any failure removes broker.pipe and the directory before returning.

Frame callback validates device, permit, ContentSize, SystemRelativeTime, QPC time, surface texture format B8G8R8A8 Count 1 and exact dims, CopyResource to staging, Map read, copy_from pool, Close frame, re-check permit, admit_frame then publish latest.
Encodes source and target as NUL-terminated UTF-16 vectors valid for the call, then moves atomically with write-through. Caller must have flushed file data first; this covers metadata journaling.

EnumWindows collects up to 4096 HWNDs, overflow aborts. collect_eligible skips hidden/minimized pre-check, observes cookie birth pid executable title class rect, re-checks visibility and cookie, then reconcile publishes only eligible windows.

Resolves handle, looks up Native raw key, verifies witness before and after CreateForWindow, checks visible and not minimized both times. Fixture keys return Unsupported; recycled witnesses return StaleWindow.
hardware_candidates orders preferred hardware first, never includes Ffv1 software fallback. Each of Nvenc, Amf, Qsv appears exactly once.

Enforces accepted-state coupling: configure_obs accepted requires obs==configured; start_chat accepted requires chat==running. Otherwise clears body, stops child, returns service_reply_rejected. Returns Ok only when accepted true else service_operation_rejected.

Finds entry by exact handle plus generation else StaleWindow. Hidden or minimized returns Unavailable. Requires exactly one visible unminimized window sharing executable class title else AmbiguousDescriptor.

Rejects any symlink ancestor and on Windows reparse points; rejects non-directories. On Linux requires uid equal to /proc/self owner and mode with no group/other bits; on Windows delegates to DACL verify.

SDDL is O:SID D:P with one full-access owner-only inheritable ACE. Pipes use max 4 instances and reject_remote_clients true. Directory and broker.pipe are created with the same explicit descriptor, not inherited defaults.

cafe root is the Windows-first capture and recording system with Electron UI, connector and MCP bridge, admission control and offline build gates. connectors is the Windows pipe entry via windows_auth and cafe_mcp launcher plus the framed stdio connector and MCP sidecar in connectors/cafe linking OBS and Twitch chat with HMAC tickets, 5s leases and TOCTOU-pinned reads. core/src is the single-authority core with loopback broker admission, SHA-chained journal with replay, capsule registry and pairing, BGRA pool with health and pipeline ticks, operator and control intents, organizer plans, paced FFmpeg recording and Windows WGC registry storage auth policy multiplexed by runtime_main. ctl is the shared-host control plane with cafe_lanes and memory_policy admission and cgroup leases, run_capped and muse_lane execution, unit.sh worktrees and link_queue gated landing. src is the Electron boundary where main supervises cafe-core over JSONL with epoch and revision, preload exposes a frozen bridge and renderer sends single-flight intents. tools builds shippables and enforces gates for bundles, packaging, extraction, routing resolve and qualify, checks and CI. ui/src is the presentation-only renderer with App shell, capsule tiles wall and grid, window browser and catalogue plus kit chrome. Interaction flows from ctl admission and tools verification to core recording and publishing, bridged by connectors to services and MCP, hosted by src sanitized snapshots and rendered by ui intents. Offers validated frames, durable media facts, leases worktrees and queued links, manifests receipts and reports, sanitized snapshots and tiles. Needs Windows pipes and ACLs, APPDATA, loopback epoch, locked journal and media roots, approved FFmpeg, Electron Node, offline toolchain pins, facade clocks and 0700 roots.

A user would see MCP startup refuse to connect: insecure rendezvous, unavailable pipe, server-changed identity, or invalid metadata errors, or immediate exit 2 when APPDATA is missing. No secret is logged or stored in metadata.
User sees connector exit code 2 with no stdout frame, or effect_result {accepted:false}: caused by malformed/oversize line, wrong epoch, expired lease, or handler raising Exception.

Operator sees blocked confirmation_required when no approval exists yet, blocked mcp_control_unavailable with no providers or bridge, or interrupted uncertain_dispatch after a lost dispatch: inspect status instead of replaying.

A tester would see bind_failed, rendezvous failures, capability_denied errors, or status showing host 127.0.0.1, port, epoch and effects count. Failed HMAC simply drops the peer with no authenticated session and no secret disclosure.

User sees recording that never starts and stays waiting, a mid-session abort with no file, or stop failing to produce a finished receipt after the window closed, device was lost, recorder errored, or stop was called twice.

User sees recording that never produces a published .mkv and stop returns an error; staged partial may remain while published file is absent because zero-frame output or decoded frame count not equal to written_frames is rejected as ArtifactInvalid.

User sees JSON states rejected/blocked/pending/observed/committed/interrupted with codes like window_titles_identical, capsule_limit, encoder_unavailable, folder_not_authorized, projection_budget_exceeded. Oversized snapshots collapse to projection_unavailable.

User sees admission refused or lanes stuck at 0: fail-closed output admitted false, capacity 0, error admission_unavailable. Overload (low memory, high load, too many writers, stopped flag) yields limit 0 without error text.

Operator sees apply-next exit 1 with status failed or error reason link_queue_precondition_or_gate_failed; patch rolled back, unit marked failed, surface red count grows, window blocked until operator commits.
User sees worker refused to start with M0/admission/budget errors, or brief rejected exit 67 when it contains PID-like or date text; interrupted lane exits 143 after waiting for owned launcher.

core/src is the single-authority capture and recording core with its Windows-first runtime foundation. Authority owns loopback broker admission and bounded framing (authority_auth), append-only SHA-chained journal with media receipts, locks and torn-suffix quarantine (authority_journal) plus deterministic replay (journal_replay). Zero-effect admission kernel (capsule_registry) and Rust-only pairing (capsule_pairing) bind capsule feeds to windows, generations and crops. Capture copies row-pitch sources into a bounded BGRA pool (capture_frame_pool), gates frames by generation, geometry, border and clocks (capture_health), and drives take-admit-pace-pump ticks to a receipt (capture_pipeline). Control gates private-stdin operator syntax (operator_protocol), authenticates broker, operator and organizer intents and dispatches durable effects (control_intents), drafts expiring recording, stop-all and send-to-OBS plans over measured Discord popouts (organizer, discord_windows), and supervises the private Python connector child (python_connector_supervisor, runtime_service_owner). Recording paces slots on absolute deadlines (recorder_pacer), supervises FFmpeg spawn, pipe, decode-validate and publish with pinned binary and encoder policy (ffmpeg_recorder, runtime_recording with Nvenc/Amf/Qsv preflight), and manages admitted capsule batches (runtime_effects). Windows layer adds D3D11/WGC source (windows_graphics_capture), HWND identity registry with reconcile and permits (windows_window_registry), exclusive host-supplied root with owner-only perms (runtime_storage, runtime_windows_security), owner-only pipe rendezvous (windows_auth), and NTFS write-through no-replace publish (windows_journal_policy). runtime_main multiplexes stdin, broker, actor effects, service completions, ticks and snapshots; main is the private-stdin entry. Offers durable control and media facts, admitted pipelines and published .mkv artifacts; needs loopback broker epoch, locked journal dir, live window registry, approved FFmpeg binary and verified media root, host root and Windows APIs.

A tester would see bind_failed, rendezvous failures, capability_denied errors, or status showing host 127.0.0.1, port, epoch and effects count. Failed HMAC simply drops the peer with no authenticated session and no secret disclosure.

A user would see recording or control operations refuse with journal_locked, journal_corrupt, journal_invalid, journal_pending, journal_media or journal_io, or a restart report Interrupted with quarantined bytes. No paths or input excerpts are included in errors.

User sees pairing refused and no recording for that feed: wrong person label, unknown capsule, already-paired role or feed, stale window layout after resize, crop outside window, or stale authority revision requiring retry with fresh snapshot.

User sees an operation refused with a short code such as stale_revision, duplicate_request_id, duplicate_role or generation_mismatch; state is unchanged and caller must retry with a fresh snapshot revision or new request id.

User sees recording stall or frames dropped after a few frames with an empty or short file: pool exhausted because consumers hold OwnedFrames, frame larger than max_frame_bytes, or source stride and slice mismatch from a changed capture size.

User sees a paused, black or never-starting capture: minimized window, unavailable border, frozen duplicate timestamps, stale source beyond budget, or a resize that forces restart before recording can continue.

User sees recording that never starts and stays waiting, a mid-session abort with no file, or stop failing to produce a finished receipt after the window closed, device was lost, recorder errored, or stop was called twice.

User sees start refused until a folder is chosen, folder_not_authorized after moving or symlinking the folder, confirmation_required or expired retries, duplicate request returning the prior receipt, or blocked state demanding recovery after disk write failure.

User sees a Discord window that cannot be selected for capture: unmeasured titles stay Unknown, wrong executable casing variants or path-qualified names are NotDiscord, and conflicting rules collapse to Unknown.

User sees recording that never produces a published .mkv and stop returns an error; staged partial may remain while published file is absent because zero-frame output or decoded frame count not equal to written_frames is rejected as ArtifactInvalid.

User sees live recording abort after a stall or wrong-size frame: pace/admit clear the preview, move to Interrupted, and later stop/interrupt/pump calls fail with State, QueueFull, Pacer or InvalidProfile instead of continuing.

User sees previously published media listed as Pending after restart when its receipt is absent, or recovery refuses to start when a file was deleted, truncated or altered, because the receipt can no longer be verified on disk.
User sees CAFE_RUNTIME_BLOCKED:<code> on stderr followed by process exit 1 when runtime startup is denied; no service is started.
User sees operator command ignored with operator_frame_rejected when JSON has an extra field, duplicate op or request_id, numeric clock, bad secret, or oversized frame; no action is taken.

User sees pending_confirmation, then completed with per-window sent/recording/encoder_session_limit rows, or rejected/expired with no rows; during execution the query reports unavailable rather than a partial result.
User sees connector reported as unavailable with its pid and epoch string after child exit or EOF; further calls immediately fail with connector_unavailable until a restart creates the next epoch.

User sees spawn rejected as handshake_timeout, handshake_closed or handshake_rejected when the child never signals ready, and lease rejected as lease_rejected when the child does not accept; no token or child output appears in the message.
User sees recording stop after a stall with TooLate or SourceStalled instead of frozen video, or a gap with repeated duplicate frames counted separately when the source is held across slots.

User sees recording stop with reason disk_write_failed, folder_not_authorized, encoder_unavailable, capture_source_unavailable, or recording_interrupted; tick/stop/abort surfaces tick failed, stop failed, abort failed with debug cause. Rejected starts show duplicate, capacity exceeded, count overflow, or capsule not found.

User sees JSON states rejected/blocked/pending/observed/committed/interrupted with codes like window_titles_identical, capsule_limit, encoder_unavailable, folder_not_authorized, projection_budget_exceeded. Oversized snapshots collapse to projection_unavailable.

User sees still window repeating last frame, not failure; closure or minimizing fails start with window or capture codes; tampered binary invalidates cached preflight and blocks hardware with encoder errors.

User sees OBS never shows configured or chat never connects despite retries. Code returns configurable false, obs_ready false, chat_ready false because body missing or closed true or messages not a positive numeric string.

User sees app refuses to start or second instance exits saying another instance is running. Happens when authority.lock is held, root is group/world accessible, a symlink is present, or requested path is relative.

User sees broker never appears or client cannot connect to local pipe. Code returns rendezvous_nonce_failed, rendezvous_bind_failed, or rendezvous_create_failed when nonce malformed, name already owned, or directory ACL denied.
