Canonical u64 means nonempty ASCII digits, no leading zeros, value within 0..18446744073709551615; JS numbers never qualify.
Plain object means non-null non-array with Object.prototype or null prototype; used to gate status, state, requests, and responses.
Transport allows GET with no payload and SUBMIT/PREVIEW with payload; wrong channel or extra GET arg throws IPC_CHANNEL_DENIED or IPC_ARGUMENTS_DENIED.
Every status object handed to renderer is frozen recursively; renderer mutation attempts fail silently or throw in strict mode.
Defines frozen renderer bridge over trusted host adapters: getSnapshot, submitIntent, onSnapshot, previewSource with no raw transport or PID paths.
Exposes the closed bridge into the isolated world via contextBridge with a fixed three-channel invoke and one-channel subscribe transport.
Thin installer delegating to exposeClosedBridge; auto-installs in renderer process and stays host-testable with mock electronApi.
Fixed channel names cafe:getSnapshot, cafe:submitIntent, cafe:snapshot, cafe:previewSource; no generic channel passthrough exists.
Preload duplicates the same four channel constants and rejects any invoke or subscribe outside that closed set.
preloadSecurity depends only on cafeBridge factory plus Electron contextBridge/ipcRenderer; index.js only re-exports installer with no platform imports.

src/renderer is the renderer-only UI control layer, implemented by control.js createControls. It validates authority snapshots and operator intents locally and sends operator_intent envelopes without interpreting queued as committed. Parts: connect/subscribe/dispose lifecycle, getState/accept snapshot projection, single-flight send, pairWindow/createCapsule/refreshWindows capsule-window management, organizer plan confirm/reject, OBS/Twitch/auto-anchor configuration, folder/ffmpeg/send/remove actions, recording-reason vocabulary, and diagnostic reporting. Interaction: connect attaches to bridge snapshot feed, accept pins epoch and deep-clones validated snapshots, getState projects frozen UI views, send emits one cafe.operator.v1 envelope at a time, all other actions recheck view flags before sending. Offers frozen views, subscriptions, and guarded intents. Needs authority bridge, snapshots, and platform/capability flags.
User clicking record with missing folder, ffmpeg, feeds, non-Windows platform, or no Running recording sees immediate rejection and no state change.
Support view shows unknown_result or null counts when last result or window lists are absent or oversized, rather than crashing on bad data.
Non-authority-ready runtime, malformed capsules/feeds/windows/page, or more than 12 capsules or 3 windows throws and yields unavailable view.
Every local validation failure throws generic Request rejected; refresh and try again with no backend detail leaked to UI text.
Confirm requires matching unexpired current plan; reject requires matching current plan; otherwise no intent is sent.
connect checks bridge shape, subscribes to snapshots, pulls initial snapshot, and degrades to unavailable on any failure; second call is a no-op.
subscribe adds view listener up to 16, emits current view immediately, and returns removal closure; disposed or oversubscribed throws.
dispose clears listeners and detaches snapshot feed once; it never stops the authority or recording.
getState projects authority snapshot into frozen UI view with platform, capsules, windows, page, recordings, flags, last result, plan, anchor.
accept size-checks, pins first authority epoch, ignores stale revisions, deep-clones snapshot, and resets to unavailable on validation failure.
pairWindow validates crop rectangle and cross-checks capsule, window token, generations, role conflicts, and token reuse before allocating feed id.
createCapsule checks label bytes and capsule cap; refreshWindows bounds offset to one million before sending list_windows with fresh nonce.
Folder/ffmpeg/send/remove actions recheck view flags, capsule existence, and Running recordings before emitting their fixed op envelope.
Diagnostic report counts capsules, feeds, and windows from read-only snapshot; readDiagnostics never submits intents and falls back to unknown on error.
send requires undisposed single-flight named op on available state, builds cafe.operator.v1 envelope, and accepts only queued-true or cancelled-true replies.
Organizer proposal accepted only with valid plan id, folder name, future u64 expiry, and 1..12 titled windows; authority expiry integer is stringified.
OBS needs configurable flag, port 1..65535, short password; Twitch needs lowercase handle; auto-anchor needs boolean and non-null capability.
Only authority-supplied recording_* codes in fixed vocabulary reach UI; unknown or missing reasons map to recording_reason_unavailable or null.
Local guards enforce canonical u64 clocks, strict identifiers, byte-bounded NUL-free text, and u32-safe integers before any send or render.
Renderer-only named-action controller: validates snapshots and intents locally, sends operator_intent envelopes, and never interprets queued as committed.
Bounds are canonical u64 max, 12 capsules, 64 KiB UI snapshot, and 14 named operator ops; authority transport has its own separate bound.
One intent at a time: pending flag blocks overlap and clears in finally; concurrent clicks throw rejected until the first reply settles.
Optional proposal data never grants effects or supplies executable paths; only plan id, folder name, expiry, and titles survive.

tools is the offline build, verification, and gating layer for cafe. It builds shippables: preload and renderer Vite bundles, Windows app staging with Electron/asar/notices/connectors/fuses/zipping, private Python runtime plus websockets wheel, shell fuse application, and the windows RC manifest. It composes and guards the explicit-source mount: build_cafe_nodes from inventory/profile with cafe_router_common canonical JSON, hashing, safe paths, and node/index/calibration contracts. It extracts language surfaces without evaluation: extract_js via pinned TypeScript AST, extract_py via stdlib AST, extract_rust via bounded tokenizer with cfg/module maps. It resolves and qualifies: resolve_cafe exact coordinate verification plus uncalibrated exploratory routing, qualify_cafe_router availability verdicts. It enforces policy gates: check_shell_archive PE/asar/fuse inspection, check_shell_fuses REQUIRED policy, check_renderer JS typecheck, check_design_tokens CSS/Vue mapping, publication_lint privacy, claims_check doc and CI claims, verify_toolchain pins, verify_clean_clone receipts, smoke_design Electron Xvfb UI, integration gate, WGC probe, secret-scan controls, and run_ci orchestration via ci_support prepared inventory and sandboxed env. Interaction is file-list in, canonical JSON out to stdout with fail-closed nonzero exits. Offers pass/blocked/fail reports, manifests, and receipts. Needs Node 24, offline cargo/rust, CPython 3.13.16 archive, Electron 44.9.2 cache, git, and pinned hashes.

User sees single-line JSON status blocked with code WINDOWS_PACKAGE_BLOCKED on stdout when any packaging gate fails.

Operator sees fail JSON with code BINARY_OR_FUSE_LAYOUT_REJECTED for unreadable binaries instead of the detailed fuse report.

User sees no surface report and a sorted JSON error with code and optional path and line on stderr plus exit 2, for example syntax_error, nonliteral_public_binding, ambiguous_public_binding, unresolved_or_imported_all_export, or invalid_or_ambiguous_ownership.

User sees no surface report and a JSON error with code path and line on stderr plus exit 2, for example unsupported_or_unterminated_literal, unbalanced_delimiter, unsupported_item, module_not_explicit_or_ambiguous, or unused_or_missing_explicit_module_path.

User sees {verdict:router unavailable, state:unavailable, calibrated:false} printed as JSON with rc 1 when any suite is empty, unverifiable, stale, or ownership fails.

Any execute exception collapses to {status:fail,reason:probe_unavailable_or_failed}; fail exits 1, not_available exits 0 with --assess else 78, pass exits 0.

Build failure records build_rc and echoes output to stderr without running tests; missing binary raises test_authority_binary_absent; any OSError/ValueError sets error integration_gate_unavailable_or_failed.
Wrong Node version, unexpected output names, empty files, or oversized assets throw RENDERER_OUTPUT or SIZE_REJECTED mapped to build rejected.
CLI accepts --check and --inventory, runs build, prints sorted JSON result, and exits 2 with canonical error on contract or IO failure.
Callable with repo root default; running as main prints JSON report and on failure prints PRELOAD_BUILD_REJECTED with exit 1.

CLI entry main parses --require-qualified and --inventory, calls collect(ROOT,inventory), summarize, validate_report, exit_code, prints sorted JSON report to stdout.

CLI main takes either positional key or --route with --ack-uncalibrated and --inventory; exactly one must be given, else ContractError select_exact_key_or_exploratory_query; writes canonical bytes to stdout.
CLI main accepts optional --stage in STAGES; runs one stage or all eight in order until first non-pass, prints {schema:cafe.ci-run.v1,status,stages} and exits 0 only on full pass.

Pins: TARGET x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, rust 1.97.0, commit 40 hex, python 3.13.16, archive PYTHON_SHA 7aba3985 with 21987516 bytes, node v24, inventory 1..4096 entries.

tools/windows is the offline Windows RC build contract for cafe, implemented by build_rc_contract.py. It produces an unsigned native-pending manifest (cafe.windows.rc-build.v1 / cafe.windows.rc-manifest.v1) and blocks on missing prerequisites rather than reporting silent success. Parts: CLI main with --verify-manifest, --preflight-only, and full-build modes; preflight gate for Windows x64, toolchains, reviewed commit, clean checkout, and pins; invoke runner for serial offline toolchain calls; build orchestrator for cargo, npm, node packager, and archive checks; inspect_zip streaming verifier; local_path/relative path canonicalizers; validate_manifest_shape/validate_manifest verifiers. Interaction: main parses absolute canonical paths, preflight inventories and pins the environment, build runs cargo release, npm preload/renderer/check, node build_windows_app.js via temp request file, and shell-archive check, then writes the manifest; verify re-checks manifest shape, disk sizes/hashes, and live zip scan. Offers: preflight_pass, built_unsigned_native_pending, and manifest_verified terminal statuses with bounded resource use. Needs: source, commit, python, python-archive, websockets-wheel, electron-cache, external new output dir, plus git, rustup 1.97.0, MSVC link.exe, node/npm 24, CPython 3.13.16 archive, build_windows_app.js, package_windows.py, check_shell_archive.py, and Cargo/package locks.
Operator sees JSON {status:blocked,code,required_command} with exit 2 naming the exact remedial command such as Get-Command link.exe or git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal.

Each prerequisite raises Blocked(code,command) with fixed codes WINDOWS_REQUIRED, TOOLCHAIN_MISSING, REVIEWED_COMMIT_MISMATCH, CLEAN_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED, RUST_PIN_REQUIRED, MSVC_LINKER_REQUIRED, and similar.

Build aborts with AUTHORITY_BINARY_MISSING, PACKAGE_NOT_VERIFIED, LOCKFILE_CHANGED, CHECKOUT_CHANGED_DURING_BUILD if exe absent, packager status differs, or Cargo/package locks or HEAD shift mid-build.

CLI main handles --verify-manifest, --preflight-only, or full build requiring source,commit,python,python-archive,websockets-wheel,electron-cache,output; prints cafe.windows.rc-build.v1 and exits 0 or 2.

preflight(source,commit,python,archive) enforces Windows x64, tool presence, reviewed commit, clean checkout, Rust 1.97.0 plus MSVC target/linker, node 24, approved python archive/exe, node cache, inventory bounds.
invoke runs argv in cwd with CARGO_NET_OFFLINE and npm offline flags, 30s default timeout; OSError maps to COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE and nonzero rc to COMMAND_FAILED showing first three basenames.

Build flow: new external output dir, preflight inventory, cargo release cafe-core for TARGET, npm preload/renderer/check, node build_windows_app.js via temp request file, shell-archive check, manifest write.
inspect_zip streams every ZIP entry hashing sha256, rejecting >20000 entries, encrypted, duplicate casefold, symlink, oversize (>2GiB total or >512MiB entry), or size mismatch rows sorted by path.

Manifest must equal {schema:cafe.windows.rc-manifest.v1,version:0.1.0-rc.1,target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc,windows_verification:pending,files,archive_files} with sorted unique casefold rows and exact artifact set.
Typed manifest verified against disk: each files row size+sha must match local artifact and archive_files must deep-equal live inspect_zip of cafe-0.1.0-rc.1.zip.
Pins: TARGET x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, rust 1.97.0, commit 40 hex, python 3.13.16, archive PYTHON_SHA 7aba3985 with 21987516 bytes, node v24, inventory 1..4096 entries.
Paths must be absolute without .., UNC prefix, symlinks, or reparse points (0x400 attr), canonical via resolve strict equality; directories checked for every ancestor.
Manifest and inventory names must be strict posix relative: str type, no backslash/colon/NUL, PurePosixPath-stable, no empty/dot/dotdot segments, no leading slash.
Offline Windows RC build contract producing unsigned native-pending manifest; missing prerequisites are blocked, never silent success; purpose is first for this file.
Terminal statuses: preflight_pass, built_unsigned_native_pending, manifest_verified exit 0; blocked with fixed code plus required_command exits 2; BUILD_REJECTED covers unexpected OSError/ValueError.
All toolchain steps run serially with per-call timeouts (15-30s, 900s for cargo/npm/package); no parallel builds or retries; request file is unlinked in finally after packager call.
Creates only new external output dir outside checkout; target dir removed in finally; manifest limited to 8MiB on verify; zip scan caps entries and bytes to bound memory and disk.
Seven build args plus --preflight-only/--verify-manifest; python archive and exe, websockets wheel, electron cache, and output must all be absolute canonical local paths, output new and external.
Depends on git, rustup 1.97.0 cargo/rustc, MSVC link.exe, node/npm 24, approved CPython 3.13.16 archive, tools/build_windows_app.js, package_windows.py, check_shell_archive.py, Cargo/package locks.
Result stays windows_verification pending and built_unsigned_native_pending; manifest shape pins that flag so a local build can never be mistaken for Windows-verified release evidence.

Offers tiles, controls, wall, plan approval, headers, dialogs, cache. Needs window.cafe facade, previewSource, mediaDevices, dockview-vue, openvue, tokens, #app and authority booleans.

User sees fixed banners: Runtime unavailable/starting, Capture needs Windows, Choose output folder/FFmpeg first, Pair a window feed first, Select a listed window, OBS/Chat setup pending, Not recording, No previous/next page. Wall shows Starting Cafe or Capsules unavailable.

User sees Partial list. Refresh to scan again or empty list after cap/incomplete, and Could not complete the window scan. Refresh to try again or Cafe is not connected. Recovery is offset-zero refresh/rescan.

Host-supplied id and data-semantic-anchor on UiButton/UiTextInput are ignored; automation querying expected ids like shell/topbar/new finds generated cuk-control-N ids instead. Selectors must target inner vendor passthrough.

User sees The window changed or closed. Select it again when selection went stale; must pick again. Discord pop-outs always sort above other matches by exe basename containing discord; intentional prioritization, not sort bug.

User sees Connecting preview, No preview, Window minimized, or Window closed tiles with notes (permission unavailable, waiting for approved source, recording can still run). Video stays hidden until live.

User sees Live preview, Connecting preview, Window minimized/closed, No preview, Recording, Recording failed. Failed tiles show reason plus review-setup-and-retry guidance; minimized shows restore hint.

User sees no unread dot but expects alerts: unreadCount is 0 or stale; screen reader hears unread count unavailable when unreadAvailable false. Typing in palette never narrows when items empty or labels lack typed substring; empty-state text appears.

Any failed controller promise sets notice to Request failed; refresh and try again. Failed diagnostics read sets Diagnostics unavailable with empty rows. Raw errors and report objects are never surfaced, logged, stored or serialized.

Creating beyond 12 capsules sets wall-limit note and refuses the request. Pair/start/stop/send handlers silently return when controls null, busy, pending, or guard (startBlock/stopBlock/sendBlock/pairBlock) non-empty.

Window browser paginates up to 256 pages via observeWindowPage; stale sequence aborts. Selection mismatch, generation drift, or unconfirmed create/pair reply sets failed or selection_stale plus fixed notice.

Missing bridge.previewSource yields preview_disabled. If shortcut lacks opensDialog and host has no shortcut-activate listener, click emits id nobody receives and nothing happens. Empty filter shows No matching entries; Enter with zero results does nothing. If #shell-command-input lookup misses, palette opens without focus.

UiButton props label required, intent default neutral, loading boolean; internal cuk-control id always used. UiTextInput v-model via modelValue/update:modelValue; TopBar palette forwards Enter. windows.vue props notice, windows, currentPage, total, status, busy, selectedId, anchored; emits select/refresh/close.

accept validates envelope, offsets, row fields, token uniqueness; offset-0 clears to loading; later pages must chain offset==nextOffset==covered with same total; appends to limit then ready/loading/incomplete/failed. observe subscribes, calls refreshWindows, stores request_id, resolves on matching offset/lastResult/requestId; collects up to 8 pre-reply values.

reconcile diffs wanted ids vs panels: removes extras, adds missing via addPanel below/right, retitles, then arrange co-locates. assign dedupes, validates, checks cap before mutating, allocates monotonic numbers. confirm emits when not busy and remaining>0. slotText/capsuleText trim-check else unknown.

visible synced to dialog.open via nextTick showModal/show or close; cancel closes only if closeOnEscape; close emits hide/after-hide. query filters paletteItems by case-insensitive substring; Enter opens results[0]. showPalette focuses #shell-command-input; Ctrl/Cmd+K opens. crumbTone defaults last crumb to accent; dialog boolean bound to CSP Dialog.

pairWindow carries capsuleId, role, windowToken, windowGeneration, layoutRevision, crop x/y/width/height; token/generation/revision only from listedWindow or cached browser row revalidated against snapshot. Diagnostics render only 9 allowlisted fields in fixed order; only fixed lowercase codes and non-negative safe ints pass.

unsigned 0..4294967295; clock decimal 1..2^64-1 matching /^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/ and <=MAX_CLOCK; token nonempty, no NUL, UTF-8<=128B. limit 1..256 else RangeError; windows<=3, end=offset+len<=total, nextOffset null iff end==total; identical replay idempotent.

Grid/registry id non-empty trimmed, no whitespace, not all digits, unique; violation collapses list to invalid or throws invalid id.

User sees slot-N alias, person name or unknown, state pill (Live preview, Recording, Window minimized/closed, No preview, Recording failed, unknown), elapsed timer or em dash with inactive/active label, and Remove button.

Missing bridge.previewSource yields preview_disabled. Grant mismatch, timeout, ended track, over-cap settings, or NotAllowedError map to later() reasons; catch maps NotAllowedError/preview_denied to preview_denied else preview_unavailable.

8s acquisition watchdog marks timedOut and emits no_preview preview_unavailable, but keeps queue slot until getDisplayMedia settles so a late grant cannot consume another tile's grant; late captures are stopped and retried.

Problem line shows failureReason (+result) for recording_failed, result text, Restore it in Windows for minimized, stop reason while recording, or rec reason with inline resolve action. OBS reason reveals only after click attempt.

Click guards re-check disabled flags before emitting, so double-click or race cannot emit while blocked. OBS wrapper click sets obsClicked to reveal reason even when disabled button swallows the event.
Local panel close never deletes a capsule: onDidRemovePanel re-runs reconcile+arrange on microtask to restore from authoritative ids. Guarded by reconciling flag against re-entrancy.
Expired or unparseable expiry blocks confirm entirely; user must request a new plan. Busy disables both buttons; result string surfaces parent authority outcome.
Failures throw coded Errors (invalid id/options/overflow). App.vue catches overflow/invalid from assign and blanks workspaceIds, causing grid invalid state rather than partial aliases.
Session starts inert; setBinding({capsule_id,feed_id,generation}) and setVisibility(show,allow) jointly gate acquisition. active() requires not disposed, enabled, visible and non-null binding.
Timer entry is sync(recordings,now): collects Running capsule_ids, stamps first-seen start time, drops stopped ids, starts interval when non-empty and ticks onTick(now) every intervalMs.
Dockview ready supplies desktopApi; wall subscribes to onDidAddGroup (hide headers) and onDidRemovePanel (restore authoritative panels). Initial reconcile plus arrange builds the grid.
Create via createRegistry({maxSlots}); default ceiling MAX_SLOTS 1000. assign(ids) in authoritative display order establishes aliases; remove, aliasFor, displayFor, activeIds query afterwards.

Acquire flow: bridge.previewSource({capsule_id,feed_id}) grant -> getDisplayMedia({audio false, ideal size/fps}) -> single-video-track check -> constrain caps -> onStream + live state. Any mismatch routes to later(reason).

Vue maps props to session: capsuleId/feed_id/generation changes call setBinding; enabled/visible/intersecting/documentVisible/window_state gate setVisibility. Stream callback sets video.srcObject and plays; play rejection forces no_preview preview_denied.
elapsedFor(capsuleId,now) renders now-start via elapsedLabel (BigInt ms->h:mm:ss, up to 20 digits). Missing start returns em dash. App.vue feeds timerTick into elapsedFor for header display.

waitForAuthorityResult subscribes to controls, checks getState immediately, resolves when view.lastResult.requestId matches and state leaves pending, when availability leaves available (unconfirmed), on 8s timeout, or on abort.
waitForProjectedMatch polls a snapshot predicate up to 60x50ms while active() holds, bridging authority-result vs snapshot arrival skew (e.g. created capsule not yet listed).

reconcile diffs wanted panel ids vs desktopApi panels: removes extras, adds missing via addPanel with position below/right of grid neighbours, retitles existing. arrange() then co-locates into one group in grid order and sizes tiles.
confirm emits only when not busy and remaining>0; reject emits when not busy. Parent App.vue gates on plan_id match and waits authority result before showing outcome.
assign dedupes preserving order, validates each id, checks next+fresh-1<=max before mutating, then allocates monotonic numbers. Reorder and delete-readd retain aliases; active reflects latest order.
slotText and capsuleText trim-check string props, falling back to unknown. displayState maps only known backend values to friendly text; stateKey collapses unknown to one styling key.

Grant contract: grant.ok true and capsule_id/feed_id must echo the requested binding; grant.error allowlist maps to reason else preview_denied. Returned stream must have exactly one video track and zero audio tracks.

Result labels are fixed and failure-only: queued/committed/observed/configured show nothing. Conflict, unconfirmed, cancelled, blocked, refused map to actionable sentences; fallback is Refresh diagnostics and try again.
Buttons block when busy or reason text non-empty; defaults block (Runtime unavailable / OBS not ready). REC also blocked while connecting or window_minimized at template level.
Panel id is capsule:<id>; tab label comes from tabLabels prop (slot-N person) with fallback to raw id. Panels use renderer always, min 160x120; floating groups disabled.
Overflow contract: exceeding maxSlots throws ERR_SLOT_OVERFLOW with coded Error, leaving existing aliases untouched. displayFor returns slot-N string or null; aliasFor numeric alias or null.
Remove blocked while busy or while stateKey is recording (title Stop recording before removing). onRemove re-checks before emitting, so disabled clicks never propagate.

Preview caps are clamped: width 1..1920, height 1..1080, frameRate max 15. constrain applies max constraints then verifies actual settings stay within caps and frameRate>0, else throws preview_unavailable.

Numeric strings validated strictly: elapsed accepts finite >=0 numbers or 1..20 digit strings; plan expiry must match digit pattern with safe-integer now. Out-of-range or malformed yields em dash or null, never NaN.
Id validator: non-empty trimmed string, no whitespace, not all digits, unique. Any violation collapses whole list to invalid with empty ids, never partial render.
Id invariant enforced on every entry point: non-empty trimmed string, no whitespace, not all digits. Violation throws ERR_INVALID_CAPSULE_ID; bad options/ids array shape throws ERR_INVALID_OPTIONS.

ui/src/kit/shell provides generic S1 app chrome: TopBar.vue (48px instrument header) and StatusBar.vue (28px telemetry footer). TopBar shows product wordmark, nav toggle, search/command palette with Ctrl/Cmd+K, role/environment/credit/clock context, speed group, notifications/help, and New action. StatusBar shows breadcrumb, live telemetry metrics, optional layout-saved flag, shortcut buttons plus shortcuts dialog. Both are host-driven presentational components: content arrives via props, regions are overridable via slots, actions leave via emits plus exposed open/close methods. Dialogs use createCspDialog-wrapped openvue/dialog with UiButton/UiTextInput. Local boolean refs hold palette/dialog/query state; no async. Needs host to supply props, handle emits, and provide tokens and dialog/button/input dependencies.
User sees missing layout indicator although layout was saved: layoutSaved left at default null renders no region. Cause is tri-state prop never set by host, not a save failure.
User clicks Shortcuts (?) and no list appears or dialog appears empty: dialog failed to open or shortcuts array empty. Dialog lists current shortcuts plus fixed Command palette Ctrl K row.
User sees no unread dot but expects alerts: unreadCount is 0 or stale prop. Screen reader instead hears unread count unavailable when unreadAvailable false, signalling missing data not zero.
User types in command palette and list never narrows: paletteItems empty or labels do not contain typed text (case-insensitive substring only). Empty state text appears instead.
If shortcut entry lacks opensDialog and host has no shortcut-activate listener, click emits id that nobody receives and nothing happens. No log or fallback; dialog stays closed.
Empty filter match shows role=status No matching entries. Try another name. Enter with zero results does nothing (results[0] guard). No error emitted.
If focus element lookup #shell-command-input misses after nextTick, palette opens but focus stays put; keyboard search requires extra click. No log produced.

Inputs arrive as props crumbs, telemetry, layoutSaved (tri-state null default), shortcuts (default Terminal/~ and Shortcuts/?). Slots breadcrumb, telemetry, layout, shortcuts override each region. Host drives dialog via exposed openShortcuts/closeShortcuts.
Shortcut clicks call activate(item): items with opensDialog open the dialog, others emit shortcut-activate with item.id. Parent wires Terminal action and dialog open from this event.

Required product string plus optional searchPlaceholder, paletteTitle, paletteItems, unreadCount/unreadAvailable, newLabel, speeds, navExpanded, role/environment/credit/clock labels. Slots nav, identity, context, search, speed, actions, primary override regions.
Emits open(item), new-capsule, speed-change(speed.id), notifications-open, help-open, toggle-nav. Exposes openPalette/closePalette for programmatic palette control.
crumbTone(crumb,index,total) returns explicit crumb.tone else accent for last crumb, dim otherwise. Template maps crumbs to li with key index-label and aria-current=page on last item.
dialog ref boolean bound v-model:visible to CSP Dialog id shell/statusbar/shortcuts-dialog. openShortcuts sets true, closeShortcuts sets false; Close button calls closeShortcuts.
query ref filters paletteItems by case-insensitive label substring into results. Enter key opens results[0]; item click calls open(item) which emits open, closes palette, clears query.
showPalette sets palette true then nextTick focuses #shell-command-input. closePalette sets palette false and clears query. Dialog visible bound to palette ref.
Global keydown shortcut listens for Ctrl/Cmd+K, preventDefault, opens palette. Registered onMounted, removed onBeforeUnmount. Search button also opens palette on click.

S1Crumb {label, tone dim|strong|accent}; S1TelemetryItem {key,value,live}; S1Shortcut {id,label,kbd,opensDialog}. layoutSaved null/undefined renders no layout region; true shows Layout saved, false Layout unsaved.
S1PaletteItem {id,label,group?}; S1SpeedOption {id,label,name,pressed?}. Speed buttons set aria-pressed from pressed and active class; click emits speed-change with id only.
Last crumb defaults to accent tone; separators / and | and live dot are aria-hidden. Telemetry block renders only when telemetry.length nonzero, so empty array shows nothing.
Notifications aria-label is unavailable message when unreadAvailable false, else N unread when unreadCount>0, else plain Notifications. Red dot renders only when unreadCount>0.

Generic S1 28px telemetry footer. Renders breadcrumb, telemetry metrics, optional layout-saved flag, and shortcut buttons plus a shortcuts dialog. Host supplies all content via props or overrides regions via slots.

Generic S1 48px instrument header. Shows product wordmark, nav toggle, search/command palette, optional role/environment/credit/clock slots, speed group, notifications/help, and New action. No app names; host supplies text via props.
Dialog state is boolean closed/open. Transitions only via openShortcuts, closeShortcuts, activate opensDialog branch. No auto-close on shortcut emit; host must act on shortcut-activate.
Palette closed/open boolean. Open via button, Ctrl+K, or openPalette; close via open(item), closePalette, or dialog dismiss. query cleared on close and on successful open.
Depends on openvue/dialog wrapped by createCspDialog from ../workspace/cspDialog.js and UiButton from ../ui/UiButton.vue. Dialog styling relies on cuk-csp-dialog and design tokens.
Depends on createCspDialog wrapper for openvue/dialog, UiButton, UiTextInput, and openvue icon components. Palette input id shell-command-input is a cross-function focus contract.
No async, locks, or timers. dialog ref updates synchronously; CSP dialog syncs visible to native showModal/close on nextTick. Rapid open/close collapses to last boolean.
Single document keydown listener per mounted instance. Multiple TopBar mounts add duplicate listeners, each opening its own palette. Cleanup on unmount only.
Footer uses overflow-x auto with fixed 28px token height; long crumbs/telemetry scroll horizontally. Dialog width uses palette-width token, max 100vw.
Header uses overflow-x clip; narrow viewports under 80em hide kbd hints and New label via media query, keeping icon buttons with accessible names.
